articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Signal Recognition Based on Ensemble Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, based on the traditional artificial feature extraction method, the ensemble learning method and the convolutional neural network method are used to identify the types of 9 kinds of analog and digital modulation signals, and the performance is evaluated and compared. It is found that the convolutional neural network has higher SNR tolerance than the ensemble learning algorithm, and has better classification performance under complex SNR conditions. The ensemble learning algorithm has better classification effect on Chirp and OFDM signals than the convolutional neural network. This research result also provides a research basis for the combination of traditional machine learning methods and deep learning methods.

articleTitle: MT-YOLO: Combination of Multi-Scale Feature Extraction and Transformer in One-Stage Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Object detection is a very important area in computer vision that can be applied to many scenarios and plays a very important role, where YOLO has become the industry standard for effective object detection. In this study, we consider enhancing the capability of YOLO for global feature modeling and design a multi-scale dilated dense connectivity module based on YOLOv5 to extract feature information at different scales and levels to obtain spatially dependent information in images, while adding a Convolutional Block Attention Module(CBAM) to learn details of the detected objects. Then, we use three Transformer Encoder-like integrations to the top of the Neck instead of on the backbone network. In this way, more meaningful, fine-grained and feature-enriched mapping relations can be obtained to extract associations about different image regions. The validation results on the COCO 2017 dataset show that MT - YOLO-S is able to achieve 44.1 % AP while being able to reach a detection speed of 115 frames, in addition, our N/M size model achieves 35.2 % % and 49.5% AP performance in the same experimental setting.

articleTitle: Challenges and Solutions for Network Security in the Information Age
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of big data, the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, 5G technology and new next-generation network technologies, network information technology is profoundly changing people's way of production and life. While internet technology brings convenience to our life and work, the ensuing network security issues such as data security, application security and system security are also becoming increasingly prominent. Therefore, network security technology, as the main means to maintain network information security, has begun to receive attention from the network security departments of various countries. From the perspective of network security governance and defense, this paper summarises the current status of network security construction and governance regulations in various countries, outlines the key technical features of firewalls, intrusion detection, data encryption and virtual private networks currently used in network security, and lays the foundation for mastering network security management technologies. Through the analysis of the current situation of network security, the challenges faced by network security in terms of hardware and software security, data security, hacker attacks and virus invasion are presented. Given the above challenges, this article gives solutions for establishing a security defense system, data management system and prediction and early warning system, to provide a reference for the construction of network information security.

articleTitle: The Impact of Organic Production and Organic Certification on Purchase Intention Based on Machine Learning and Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This study uses machine learning and text analysis methods to explore whether organic production and organic certification affect the purchase of organic products. Organic tea was selected as the research object and analyzed through the collection of online comment texts and questionnaire data. It is found that there were no significant differences between gender and age groups in the attention paid to organic tea production, organic certification, and organic tea quality. According to the binary metalogic regression and XGBoost algorithm of machine learning, the quality of organic tea is the most important factor affecting consumers' willingness to buy organic tea. In addition, the understanding of organic production and confidence in organic certification will affect the purchase behavior of organic tea. From the term frequency and semantic network, it can be found that consumers believe that organic tea is a durable, mellow, and high-quality product, which is worth promoting.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Community Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology in recent years, Internet technology has been widely used in various industries. With the sustained development of China's economic situation, people's demand for community housing has changed greatly. Now people hope that the living conditions will be safer and more convenient, and the property services will be perfect and effective. Smart community is a new type of community that combines the technologies of Internet of Things and cloud computing to achieve a safe and comfortable living experience. The application of Internet technology in wireless city is in the exploratory stage, and the existing applications have some problems such as incomplete service functions. It is of great significance to establish a scientific and advanced intelligent community service information management system. This paper summarizes the framework of smart community service information management system, introduces the structural design of smart community information management system, and verifies the reliability of the system through experimental tests.

articleTitle: Model Poisoning Attack In Federated Learning Via Adversarial Examples
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The emergence of federated learning framework sets protects user privacy and has solved the Isolated Data Island problem. However, existing federation attack methods mostly use label flipping for data poisoning attacks, while federated backdoor attacks require patching the target samples. The attacker can also arrange other generative networks at local nodes but has limited data reconstruction capability. Thus, this paper proposes a new poisoning attack method named adversarial example poisoning attack (AEP A). The attacker uses the distributed global model to create adversarial examples and uses the original clean label for federation training and attacks against the specific target class in the dataset. In the evaluation process, we conducted extensive experiments on the CfF AR-l 0 dataset. We also explored the toxicity of the adversarial examples under different generation methods, compared our method with the label-flipping attack, and finally showed the effectiveness of AEPA.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Edge Detection Technology Based on Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: To meet the requirement of realtime and correct edge detection in complicated image segmentation, a speedy edge detection technological know-how based totally on optimization mannequin was once proposed. The optimization mannequin of deep mastering is adopted, the image object is taken as the segmentation unit, the image is divided through pixel, and then the segmentation image is merged based totally on certain rules. A giant wide variety of spots or noise after image segmentation are reduced, and the variety of pixel factors in the incorrect division is reduced It shortens the detection time and improves the detection efficiency, and has sure benefits in contrast with the classical Log, Canny and Pal. King algorithms.

articleTitle: Lapa: Multi-Label-Flipping Adversarial Attacks on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In recent years, the robustness of graph neural networks (GNNs) adversarial attacks has been favored by researchers, and related research has intensified. However, existing graph adversarial attacks are mainly performed by modifying the topology of the graph and node feature vectors, and attacks from the labels of nodes are rarely considered, especially for multi-label graph adversarial attacks, where an attacker can manipulate an obscure portion of the training labels and flip the sample labels in the training data to other classes, resulting in incorrect predictions of the retrained GNNs model. In this work, we present graph adversarial attack against multi-label flipping. We propose an effective attack model-Lapa, based on an adaptive genetic algorithm that searches the solution space for suitable adversarial samples to obtain near-optimal solutions. The adaptive genetic algorithm performs crossover and mutation operations utilizing adaptive probabilities. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed Lapa attack model on GNNs after extensive experiments on four real datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Wellbore Safety Evaluation Technology Considering Corrosion Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of wellbore failure caused by corrosion, a finite element model of formation - cement ring - casing with composite corrosion defects was established. The finite element method was used to analyze the stress distribution state of wellbore corrosion pits along the axial and circumferential direction, and the safety evaluation of wellbore casing was carried out. In this paper, a model optimization method is proposed based on the finite element theory, and the traditional safety evaluation method is modified. By comparing the calculation results of the finite element method and the specification results, it is found that the specification is relatively conservative, and the evaluation method based on numerical calculation can extend the service life of casing, reduce the production cost and improve the economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on MAC Improvement Scheme Based on LoRaWAn
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: As a set of communication protocol and system architecture of LoRa technology, LoRaWAN's MAC layer design is too simple. All nodes use pure ALOHA (P-ALOHA) to access the channel. When the number of nodes is large, the probability of node collision is very high, which will cause the channel to not work properly. The existing LoRaWAN MAC layer access protocol is not suitable for periodic service transmission due to its strong randomness. In view of the limitations of LoRa Wan protocol, an access scheme suitable for periodic service is studied. First of all, the access scheme combining S-ALOHA and TDMA is adopted under the superframe structure, and the burst service is integrated into the periodic service channel. The node can transmit burst data by competing for the unallocated TDMA timeslot to improve channel utilization and reduce collision. Secondly, using the structure of superframe, nodes with different cycle lengths can be sent in the same channel. Finally, a method is designed to distribute multiple nodes to different multiframes of a superframe for node access or sending burst data, which can effectively reduce the collision caused by a large number of nodes sending data in the same multiframe. Through MATLAB simulation, it is found that this access scheme can significantly reduce the collision rate and improve the channel utilization compared with the original LoRa WAn protocol.

articleTitle: Study on Wideband Harmonic Instability of Wind Farm Based on the Vector Fitting Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The distributed parameter characteristics of the feeders can easily cause wideband harmonic instability (WHI), when the distributed generation power plants (DGPP) are connected to weak grids through long transmission lines or cables. The existing studies evaluating the harmonic instability of DGPP usually utilize the lumped parameter models of feeders, which are inaccurate for the WHI analysis. However, if the distributed parameter characteristics are considered, the pole equation of the system becomes transcendental with a complex hyperbolic function, which makes it hard to determine the pole distributions. Given this, this paper proposes a vector fitting method to obtain the pole distributions in considering the distributed parameters of feeders. Thus, more accurate and complete pole distributions can be obtained, and the results for system stability evaluation are more reliable in a wider frequency range.

articleTitle: The Artificial Intelligence Revolution Led by ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: ChatGPT has ushered in a new era of generative artificial intelligence (GAI), which may change our traditional way of thinking. Unlike the previous “metaverse”, the hype caused by GAI is essentially the emergence of long-term accumulation of language big model technology. This article explores the relationship between GAI and NLP, the background, significance, and future of GAI, as well as the basic principles of ChatGPT. The purpose is to find new business opportunities for artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Neural Machine Translation Performance with Multi-Source Input Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this thesis, we present a new approach to improving NMT performance by incorporating data from many sources.Our findings demonstrate the method's use for improving translation quality under constraints and expanding the NMT system's adaptability to different language contexts.Our method offers a constructive way forward for NMT study and has significant implications for the development of more reliable and precise NLP models.

articleTitle: Automatic Classfication of Tongue Color Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Although machine learning has been the hotpoint in the computer-aided Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis, it has some inherent disadvantages. For example, tongue image data are always insufficient as a result of no two identical tongues; the images have to be labeled manually, which involve subjectivity and randomness. Therefore, it is still necessary to improve the tongue diagnosis methods based on image processing technology and others. This paper propose a novel and simple tongue body segmentation method based on the RGB model, and then an automatic tongue color classification method is presented on basis of the segmented tongue image. The experimental results show that the tongue segmentation, tongue body & fur separation, and color recognition algorithms proposed in this paper are easy to operate, strong in practicability and high in accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Interaction Design of Smart Home Products Based on the Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the development of IoT technology, the products for the intelligent home have emerged, they must not only meet the traditional functions of life and use, but also use the technology of intelligent sensors, the technology of gateways, so on and so forth. Provide users with a fuller and smarter information interaction experience. The article explains the category and technical support of smart home products, study and compare the characteristics of its interaction design at this stage, summarize the interactive design principles of smart home products in the IoT scenario, looking ahead to the development of related fields in the future.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Control System for Production of 700000 Ton High Speed Wire Rod
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to achieve information sharing between field equipment on the one hand and more effectively complete control system tasks on the other, a set of distributed control systems based on Industrial Ethernet and PROFIBUS-DP fieldbus is created for a 700,000 ton high-speed wire automation production line in this paper. The ET200M distributed I/O station and industrial Ethernet are employed throughout the whole network system, efficiently resolving the control issues brought on by dispersed field equipment and rigorous control coordination needs.

articleTitle: A MCMC Algorithm for Improved Bayesian Network Structure Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The Bayesian network is a probabilistic graph model based on causal modeling and uncertainty reasoning. It gives the probability relationship between variables so that the posterior probability of the desired result can be calculated. In the fields of machine learning and artificial intelligence, it is commonly employed. The structural learning of Bayesian networks is the focus and complexity of study since the variables can build multiple network topologies and so form complex models. The application of an enhanced MCMC approach for network structure search is investigated in this research. A multi-step proposed distribution based on the Metropolis-Hastings method decreases computational cost, optimizes the solution process, and enhances the MCMC chain convergence speed. The approach is also used to solve a Bayesian network structure learning problem. The results of the experiments demonstrate.

articleTitle: Prompt Learning Under the Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the emergence of models such as chatGPT and Baidu AI Wenxin Yiyan, the research and application of NLP (Natural Language Processing) is increasingly centered on PLM (Pretrained Language Model),It marks that the current machine learning model has reached a new height. This article first introduces the background of the large language model, and introduces pre-training + fine-tuning and the current popular Prompt from the four major paradigms of NLP. Understand the workflow and function of Prompt, focusing on Prompt engineering, and structures, and looking ahead to future challenges for Prompt.

articleTitle: Non-Contact Heart Rate Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Mm-wave FMCW radar technology for measurement vital signs has great medical value. However, it is an arduous task to realize high-precision heartbeat rate detection for the sake human motion and various interference. This paper proposes a non-contact heartbeat rate detection technique framework based on deep learning to eliminate different interferences. (a) The vital sign signal is pre-processed to exact the phase difference. (b) Heartbeat signals were extracted from the pre-processed signals collected by FMCW radar using Variational Mode Extraction (VME). (c) Different heart rate signals are trained in the Physio Net ECG-ID database using a wavelet scattering network (WSN)-long short-term memory network (LSTM). And the heartbeat signals obtained from the VME decomposition are fed into the training network to determine the heartbeat signal state. The state of the heartbeat signal in turn changes the reference noise of the recursive least squares (RLS) based adaptive filter. (d) Noise, artifacts, and other unwanted signals are filtered out using an adaptive filter. Finally, we perform heart rate estimation on the processed heartbeat signal using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). This method achieves heart rate detection in different states and is easy to implement. To verify the heart rate detection accuracy of our method, the results are compared with a reliable reference sensor. The results showed that the mean absolute error (MAE) of heart rate of this proposed framework in different states was lower than that of the original method.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of University Users' Experience of Web Services on the Web Using SPSS and AMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Based on equity theory and resource exchange theory, SPSS and AMOS were used to construct a theoretical model of the effectiveness of fair remedies on remedial outcomes in the context of online shopping errors, using the results of a study of 329 university students as data. The results show that outcome fair remedies all have a significant positive impact on customer satisfaction; remedies significantly increase the satisfaction of progressively inclined customers compared to physically inclined customers. In addition, the combination of outcome fair remedies, procedural fair remedies and exchange fair remedies can be effective in increasing both attitudinal satisfaction and behavioural loyalty among customers. The findings of this paper provide theoretical guidance for service providers in developing remedial strategies.

articleTitle: CFD Simulation and Application of Interior Flow Field for Scroll Compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the development of CFD technology, it plays increasingly critical role in the sphere of scroll compressor. According with an existing physical model of scroll compressor, simplified and built its quasi-static calculation model under a state during its working process. Then, by using CFD software-FLUENT, simulated it to get its flow characteristics and pressure loss. On this basic, optimized the original model to get two modified structural models and calculated and compared. The result shows that the pressure loss is greatly reduced and the leakage length of them is also increasingly decreased. This will provide a theoretical reference for further study of scroll profile.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Closed Jet Fuse
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the monitoring technology of closed jet fuse, an intelligent monitoring device of closed jet fuse is designed in this paper, which consists of a state sensing unit and a state monitoring unit. The sampling & processing technology of current, electric field and optical signal and the three-stage power mode of “CT power taking-super capacitor-lithium battery” are introduced, and the sampling program and the alarm program are designed. The operation effect of each module is verified by pilot application. The design can monitor the state of the fuse in real time, effectively reduce the operation and maintenance cost, improve the efficiency of fault handling, and improve the reliability and security of power supply in the distribution network.

Author Keywords: Intelligent fuse;Signal sampling & processing;CT power taking

articleTitle: Prediction of Urban Green Development Satisfaction Based on Naive Bayesian Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This study established a naive Bayesian algorithm to predict Xiamen citizens' satisfaction with green development and found that the naive Bayesian algorithm has an excellent predictive ability. The prediction results of the naive Bayesian algorithm are superior to the random forest, KNN, LightGBM, GBDT, Bp neural network, SVM, and XGBoost. Through the naive Bayesian algorithm, it was found that the most important factor for citizens to give a high degree of satisfaction evaluation to urban green development is their high satisfaction with government actions to implement green development. Secondly, I am satisfied with the quality of infrastructure such as parks and green spaces. The main reason why citizens have a low evaluation of urban green development is their dissatisfaction with the quality of the surrounding environment, followed by their dissatisfaction with the green production performance of enterprises.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of EMC Laboratory Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper analyzes the design framework and process of the EMC laboratory information management system. Combined with the characteristics of electromagnetic compatibility testing, the functional modules and forward-looking of the system are discussed, providing reference for system development and design, so as to build a high-efficiency, standardized, multi-dimensional electromagnetic compatibility information system.

articleTitle: Evaluating Batch-to-Batch Product Control Stability Based on the Similarity of Moisture Content Curves in the Whole Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Through 32 batches of silk making process of grade A and grade B, observe the moisture content data in the processes of loose moisture regain, feeding, shredding, drying of shredded tobacco, winnowing of shredded leaves, flavoring and shredded shreds storage, and form the moisture content curve and standard reference curve. The processing strength of the batches is characterized and evaluated using curve similarity. The consistency of the curve represents the degree of homogenization of product quality and the stability of control between batches.The results show:1) The similarity of the curves can be used to evaluate the product stability. The similarity of the water content curve of brand A is higher than that of brand B, and the control level and stability of brand A are better.2) Cosine similarity and distance similarity have little difference in the results when identifying batches with low similarity curves. In identifying abnormal batches, the boundary line needs to be set according to the actual situation. The standardization treatment of different brand groups does not affect the comparison of the similarity of the moisture content curves within the group, but the advantages and disadvantages of the groups A and B cannot be compared.3) The similarity clustering of the moisture content curves can not only visually display the stability of the cigarette processing process, but also distinguish brands with different process standards.4) It is discussed that when the curve similarity is used to evaluate the stability of product batches in the manufacturing process, the moisture content of different processes is combined to change the quality evaluation method of single process and single parameter in the past. However, the multi-feature evaluation of different unit parameters in multiple processes needs further in-depth research.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Application of Knowledge Graph in Modern Chinese Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: A knowledge graph is a structured semantic knowledge base that provides organized descriptions of the entities, properties, and interactions between entities in the real world. In course teaching, knowledge graph provides learners with an effective way of course learning. Knowledge graph presents the knowledge system of a course to learners in the form of visualization, which promotes the construction of the knowledge framework of the course and improves the learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Practical Control Measures of Deflection Difference in Bridge Widening
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to reduce the deflection difference between the edges of existing deck and new deck in the bridge widening project, numerical simulation is conducted to analyse the three deflection difference control measures: traffic limitation, pouring the diaphragm before pouring the joint, and pouring the wet joint in different time sections. The results show that these three deflection difference control measures can significantly reduce the deflection difference during the bridge widening.

articleTitle: Clothing Style Diagram Retrieval Technology Based on VGG
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the application of deep learning model in sketch retrieval, this paper uses transfer learning method combined with deep learning method to transfer the image feature extraction method of VGG pretrained model to the feature retrieval of hand-drawn sketches of clothing style drawings. Select VGG's latest deep learning models VGG16 and VGG19 to conduct clothing style image retrieval experiments, and compare the retrieval performance of two different deep models. The experiment first uses the depth model to extract image features from the style map dataset and hand-drawn sketches. Secondly, the Euclidean distance is used to calculate the distance between the feature value of the retrieval sketch and the feature value of the image in the existing style atlas, and compare and match the most similar image. Finally, the image similarity is calculated, and the corresponding image is retrieved and output. The experimental results show that the retrieval effect of VGG19 is better than that of VGG16. The retrieval accuracy rate of VGG16 is 28%, and the return rate is 50%, while the retrieval accuracy rate of VGG19 can reach 43%, and the return rate can reach 70%.

articleTitle: Application of Numerical Simulation of Nanospheres in Z212 Fractured Reservoir with Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In view of the obvious high water content characteristics of fractured reservoirs in the late stage of development, compared with the application effects of three plugging agents, the nano-microsphere system was preferred as fractured reservoir plugging agent, and it was applied to Z212 block. Through the combination of indoor physics simulation experiment and numerical simulation, the nanosphere system evaluation was carried out, and the experimental results showed that the nanosphere system had good sealing performance for fractured reservoirs, and the numerical simulation results had consistent effect with the experiment. The injection parameters of the nanosphere system were optimized and the development scheme was predicted. After the implementation of nanosphere measures, the oil recovery rate was increased by 5.86%, and the cumulative oil increase reached 31.675×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>t, which effectively improved the problem of premature flooding in fractured reservoirs and achieved a good sealing and oil enhancement effect. It shows that nanospheres can be blocked-transport-re-blocked to a certain extent, which has obvious applications for effectively prolonging the stable production life and achieving economic benefit growth.

articleTitle: Construction Methods, Devices, Computer Equipment and Storage Media of Temporary Entity Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The construction method, device, computer equipment and storage media of temporary entity model, obtain the list of temporary entity, and create the standardized database data of each type of temporary entity in the list of temporary entity through the building model construction program; Based on format conversion plug-in, format conversion of the file data of the standardized improvised family library is carried out and then imported to the game development engine; Based on the import results, a background model family library is constructed in the game development engine with the usage information, usage material and specification data of the temporary entity; According to the click instruction, the selected ad-hoc entity model in the background model family library is displayed through the game development engine, and the modeling error correction of the selected ad-hoc entity model is carried out. Therefore, it is convenient to simplify the operation of user construction scheme, facilitate the preparation of temporary construction scheme, and meet the calculation demand of temporary construction.

articleTitle: Based on Abaqus Finite Element Analysis Software to Assist the Construction of Super Large Caisson
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Convex” caisson is to design caisson into a non-round, non-rectangular, non-square plane shape, forming a convex plane structure form. This kind of caisson is more difficult to make than regular caisson, and because of the uneven and asymmetrical distribution of body weight, it is easy to cause the well body to skew in the sinking stage, which puts forward higher requirements for subsidence control, and the difficulty of deviation correction is also higher than ordinary regular caisson. From the three aspects of sinking process control, construction process optimization, whole process numerical simulation, the whole process of caisson construction process control and monitoring. The settlement accuracy is controlled and the disturbance to surrounding soil is reduced by installing brake pile at the edge foot, maintaining steel sheet pile and sealing the bottom of high-pressure jet grouting pile. Adjusting the sinking times and sinking depth of caisson by optimizing the technological process; The deformation and stress concentration of caisson and surrounding soil were analyzed by numerical simulation, and the numerical simulation calculation results were verified by monitoring in the construction process to ensure the construction effect and safety.

articleTitle: Fast Image Interaction Technology Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Collision detection is mainly used to determine whether two (or more) objects intersect in the virtual environment. A new method of spatial triangle intersection detection based on hierarchical bounding box is proposed, which uses the idea of projection feedback segmentation and surface cell extraction to quickly eliminate most of the patch elements that do not participate in accurate collision detection, and reduces the amount of memory space by using model cache technology. The experimental results show that the intersection detection process reduces the number of accurately detected triangles and improves the efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Reconstruction Algorithm of Citrus Seedlings Based on Multi-View Geometry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper presents a rapid 3D reconstruction method for phenotype analysis of citrus seedlings. To address the current problems of difficult operation, high complexity and high equipment cost in acquiring point clouds based on laser scanning equipment, the authors directly use the images acquired by common shooting equipment to complete the 3D reconstruction of citrus seedlings. A three-dimensional reconstruction architecture integrating the structure of motion recovery (SFM) algorithm, multi-view dense matching (CMVS+PMVS) based on cluster and facet models, and filtering of the generated three-dimensional model is established. The final result of this method is better and simpler, faster and more resistant to interference.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Multi-Dimensional Perception and Control System for Battery in Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The existing battery management system has some shortcomings, such as uneven precision of battery state detection, extensive granularity of battery control, inaccurate battery state estimation and high maintenance cost. In this paper, a multi-dimensional perception and control system of substation battery is deeply studied and designed. The four components of the system, single switch, measurement and control module, centralized controller and master switch, are introduced. Based on the concept of multi-dimensional perception and control technology, the system adopts matrix reconfigurable battery management and control technology, monomer isolation and active equalization technology, and APP software-defined information technology, which can effectively integrate battery resources and realize the information of battery operation and maintenance. The test results show that the system can isolate the faulty battery at millisecond level, monitor and control the battery system with multi-dimension and high precision, improve the intelligence of substation battery maintenance, and improve the efficiency of monitoring and management of the whole life cycle of substation battery.

articleTitle: Research on PEMFC Air System Based on PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The performance of PEMFC is related to the stack itself and also influenced by the control effect of external systems. The air supply system, as an important subsystem, is crucial for ensuring sufficient and appropriate oxygen supply control. The parameter control of the air system has a great influence on the operational status of the entire fuel cell system. In order to analyse the factors affecting the dynamic characteristics of the air system and the polarization characteristics of fuel cells, this paper conducted simulation research on the air system using the AMESim model. PID Control variates was used to study and analyse the influence factors such as environmental parameters, the speed of the air compressor, inlet air temperature and humidity, the pressure of the valve opening. The effectiveness of PID control and the accuracy of the system model were verified according to the simulation results.

articleTitle: SQL Injection Detection Method Based on N-Gram and TFIDF
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, various SQL injection attack tools emerge one after another, and the types of attacks are varied. SQL injection has always been the main problem of network security. Therefore, this paper proposes an intrusion detection method based on N-Gram and tfidf(term frequency inverse document frequency). The core idea is using N-Gram to select feature words in the preprocessing stage and TFIDF to vectorize SQL sentences. Then on the basis of this data set the SVM classifier is trained. Finally, the classification effect is tested by comparing with existing research. Experimental results show that, compared with using predefined feature vectors directly, this method can improve the accuracy on the basis of ensuring the recall rate.

articleTitle: Finite time thermodynamic model analysis of CTHP cycle system based on calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The development and application of finite time thermodynamics are summarized. It includes the optimization of thermal process and device performance under finite time and limited size constraints. The optimization parameters of the actual thermal system, such as the heat exchange area and the temperature of all levels of cold and heat sources, are summarized. The change law of the thermodynamic parameters of the CTHP cycle system and the relevant influencing factors of the best heating rate can be calculated and analyzed by establishing the finite time thermodynamic model of the CTHP cycle system. According to the time mismatch of energy, the application status of phase change materials is reviewed. Compared with the classical thermodynamics, its mathematical model is closer to the actual situation. Finally, it points out the application direction: for one kind of problems, the accuracy is slightly improved compared with the classical thermodynamics; the other one can solve the problem that the classical thermodynamics can not reflect the actual situation in terms of system performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Diabetes Diagnosis Model Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The objective of this study is to develop a diabetes diagnosis model utilizing three distinct algorithms, namely the neural network algorithm, C&R tree algorithm, and SVM algorithm with various kernel functions. The model with the best classification performance is selected, and further optimized using the Bagging ensemble learning method. Finally, the performance of the optimized model is evaluated to determine the best diabetes diagnosis model. To conduct the experiments, we utilize the Parmenidean Diabetes dataset in the UCI database. Our experimental results demonstrate that the neural network algorithm outperforms the other two algorithms in terms of classification performance. Furthermore, the performance of the neural network model optimized by the Bagging ensemble learning method is significantly improved. The optimized model achieves an F1 score of 0.88 and an AUC score of 0.93, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed model. This optimized model provides novel insights for effectively diagnosing diabetes.

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning and Text Analysis to Improve the Operational Strategies of Historical Culture Scenic Spots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper applies machine learning and text analysis to the operation of historical culture scenic spots to verify the effectiveness and universality of the application of machine learning and text analysis. We use the random forest algorithm and the binary logistic regression method to analyze and predict the experience perception and revisit willingness of historical culture scenic spots, find out the important factors that affect tourists' revisit willingness, and explore the experience perception and concerns of tourist attractions through the term frequency and semantic networks of text analysis. Based on the results of data analysis and data mining, propose strategies to improve the operation of historical and cultural scenic spots.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Incremental Event Detection Method Based on External Knowledge for Sample Preservation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The few-shot incremental event detection task requires model can incrementally learning with a limited sample. This task facilitates rapid text categorization. Existing methods for sample retention have been found to produce prototype bias issues resulting from the small sample size. To address this problem, we introduce a novel approach that utilizes external knowledge for sample retention. Our method involves the use of encoded external knowledge and samples as prototypes, from which we select a retention sample. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our method in reducing prototype bias.

articleTitle: Calculation of Recrystallization Kinetics of Mn-Nb-Cu-B Microalloyed Low-Carbon Steel Based on Avrami Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The recrystallization behavior of Mn-Nb-Cu-B micro alloyed low-carbon steel was studied using stress relaxation experiments. The stress-strain curves of the stress relaxation process under different process conditions were measured on the thermal simulation testing machine. By analyzing the curve trend, it can be determined whether the austenite is in the recrystallized or non-recrystallized zone after a certain predeformation at a certain temperature. In the austenite recrystallization zone, recrystallization kinetics curves were obtained at different temperatures and deformation rates. Meanwhile, based on the experimental results, the formula for calculating the recrystallization start time and the recrystallization kinetics equation of the studied steel grade were proposed, and the calculated values were in good agreement with the experimental values.

articleTitle: Exploration of Multimodal Online Teaching Based on Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Based on computer network and guided by multimodal theory, this paper studies the integration and innovation of the two in online teaching. In the online class, the comprehensive application of image modality, video modality, kinesthetic modality, tactile modality and language modality is completed with the help of the relevant functions of the computer, so as to improve the limitations of online teaching, enhance students' sensory participation and improve the effect of online teaching. Teachers should pay attention to the use of kinesthetic modality and select novel materials for online teaching.

articleTitle: Source of Intelligent Manufacturing and Industrial Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The concept of “big data” in basic scientific research, such as meteorological map analysis, big physics true computing, and gene map analysis. In the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup>century, the Internet, e-commerce, mobile Internet, social network, Internet of things, and other technologies are developing rapidly, big data has become the inevitable product of the development of this new generation of information technology. Big data has the characteristics of a large amount of data, complex data types, and high realtime requirements of data processing. The wide application of big data analysis in the field of the Internet and e-commerce has produced great commercial value and has been highly valued by all countries in the world. Big data is the next area of innovation, competition, and productivity, according to McKinsey, a world-famous strategic consulting company.

articleTitle: The Application of AI System in CHD Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, as the AI system is finding application into the medical field, the development of AI system doesn't happen only in a single field, but also in the diagnoses and treatments of all kinds of diseases, and other fields such as CT, X-ray, MRI etc. With the development of AI technology, medical image AI, auxiliary diagnosis reminder, surgical robots, medical service robot, medical voice identification and input, medical data platform and precision medicine are gradually being replaced, so the diagnoses and treatments of diseases are coming into a new era. Exploring the application of AI system in medical and health services, in particular applicable to the field of CHD diagnosis, seems to have more advantages than disadvantages, in all the aspects, benefiting the nation and the people.

articleTitle: An APP Privacy Information Leakage Detection Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the increasing number and types of APP vulnerabilities, the detection technology and methods need to be enriched and personalized according to different types of security vulnerabilities. Therefore, a single detection technology can no longer meet the needs of business security diversity. First of all, the new detection method needs to clarify the relevant features of APP business security; Secondly, the new detection method needs to re-adapt the features related to APP business security; Thirdly, the new detection method needs to be trained and applied according to different AI algorithms. In view of this, we designed an APP privacy information leakage detection scheme based on deep learning. This scheme specifically selects business security-related features for the type of privacy information leakage vulnerability of APP, and then performs feature processing and adaptation to become the input parameters of CNN network algorithm. Finally, we train and call the CNN network algorithm. We selected the APP of the Telecom Tianyi Space App Store for experiment to evaluate the effectiveness of our APP privacy information leakage detection system based on CNN network. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of our proposed detection system has achieved the desired effect.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Association Design Method of Complex Assembly
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper proposes a parameter association design method that complies with complex assemblies. Through dimension constraints and design parameters, the parameters are transferred from the main parameters of assembly to the secondary parameters of assembly components. To ensure the assembly and its component structure, the main parameters and secondary parameters are constrained. For automobile engine device of complex assembly, top-down parameterized design is carried out by using the secondary development tool Creo /Toolkit, verifying the feasibility of method for the parametric design of complex assemblies. This method can be used for the rapid serial design of any complex assembly.

articleTitle: Research on the Measurement Methods of Motor Vehicle Point-to-Point Speed Measurement Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper introduces the operating principle, the main specifications and the corresponding measurement methods of the motor vehicle point-to-point speed measurement system. This paper focuses on the measurement methods and the selection of the measurement standard of the interval distance, which is the key specifications of the system. At the beginning of this paper, the operating principle and the application situation of the system are introduced. Then, starting with the principle formula, the technical index requirements, the measurement methods and the measurement standard of the interval distance, the speed measurement range, the simulation speed measurement error and the field test speed measurement error are described respectively.

Author Keywords: motor vehicle point-to-point speed measurement system

articleTitle: Application of HSV Model in Tongue Shape Recognition of TCM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The HSV colour space model is an intuitive cone colour model. Because the tongue is much redder than the whole face, and the lips are also much redder than other parts of the face, this paper adopts the HSV space model, and use the H component to separate the lips and tongue from the rest. Furthermore, since there is saliva on the surface of the tongue, it is easy to reflect when it is exposed to light, so the brightness of the tongue area is higher than that of the lips without saliva, and the tongue and lips can be separated by using the V component. The two are combined to obtain a relatively complete tongue image. Thus the HSV model is employed to propose a novel and effective tongue shape recognition method for the three shapes. The proposed method is also simple and easy to implement. Experimental results show that the propose method can improve the diagnosis efficiency, and the accuracy rate is higher than 92%.

articleTitle: Performance Calculation and Analysis of Air Source Heat Pump Water Heater
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, air source heat pump water heater units are widely used and have formed relevant national standards. However, the unit energy efficiency ratio is greatly affected by the outdoor meteorological conditions, and the hot water demand usually varies with the season and the user's water use habits. It is difficult to accurately and objectively reflect the actual energy saving effect only by using the unit operating energy efficiency ratio under nominal conditions. In this paper, the finite-time thermodynamic analysis method is introduced for four cities with typical distribution of air source heat pump water heater units, combined with regional meteorological conditions and actual application of users. A continuous energy efficiency evaluation integral model is proposed. Then the actual energy efficiency of the air source heat pump water heater unit is evaluated based on the annual comprehensive operating conditions to determine a more reasonable evaluation standard. The analysis results show that the comprehensive energy efficiency evaluation of the air source heat pump water heater unit is more accurate and more in line with the actual operation of the system by using the annual comprehensive operation hourly working condition as the reference working point. This case can be used as a reference for the evaluation of this type of thermal system.

Author Keywords: Air source heat pump water heater unit
Hourly operation conditions throughout the year

articleTitle: Power Transmission and Transformation Project Cost Dynamic Management and Realization Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Because of the large-scale construction of power transmission and the limitations of the cost management system, this paper studies that the construction of power transmission and transformation project cost information dynamic management system which is the inevitable trend under the background of big data era. This paper introduces the framework, construction mode and technical requirements of the dynamic management system of power transmission and transformation project cost information, and takes an example to prove the practicability of the system. The research results can be applied to the cost control of power transmission and transformation projects, promote the innovation of cost management mode, and improve the cost management efficiency and lean level.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Macro-Micro Linear Feed System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The requirement of ultra-precision machining technology in aerospace, micro-electromechanical, large-scale integrated circuit and other high-tech industries is increasing day by day. Macro-micro dual-drive technology has high practical value and application prospect for improving the accuracy of the machine tool feeding system and improving the ultra-precision position control system. In this paper, the macro-micro dual-drive feed system composed of piezoelectric ceramic brake and servo motor is studied. Through the hardware design and the establishment of the control system, the macro-micro point position control scheme and linkage control scheme are proposed, and the control precision of each control scheme is tested experimentally to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme. At the same time, the point position control scheme is applied to the turning center.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Resilient Community Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the development of resilient communities, there is an increasingly intelligent and efficient demand for community landscape design work, as well as community residents' requirements for high-quality and high-tech communities. Now, the intelligence of the community landscape, the interaction between the community landscape and the residents, and the psychological feelings of the residents have become important factors in evaluating the resilience of the community. Combined with the current computer development technology, a community planning scheme based on virtual simulation is proposed. This study designs community landscape planning based on virtual simulation from the aspects of system function, overall simulation platform and specific design, hoping to provide some reference for the development of community landscape.

articleTitle: Status, Hotspots and Evolutionary Path of Foreign Research on Digital Immersion Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Digital immersive art has received a lot of attention in recent years, and research results are abundant. In order to explore the progress of international research on digital immersive art and to grasp the development direction and evolution trend of the field of digital immersive art, the article borrows the knowledge mapping software CiteSpace and conducts a visual analysis of the countries or regions, highly productive authors and institutions, and keywords of 1457 documents on digital immersive art selected from the WOS core collection database. The study found that the current research in the field of digital immersive art continues to increase in interest, with close collaboration between authors and loose collaboration between institutions. Research hotspots are mainly focused on virtual reality, digital art, immersive interaction, and games. Neutral networks, artificial intelligence, and deep learning are also receiving continued attention.

articleTitle: Research on Cable Support System of Prefabricated Building Composite Floor Based on Numerical Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, there are some problems in the construction of large-span composite floor slabs in prefabricated buildings, such as cumbersome construction of temporary support systems and easy instability. In order to solve the above problems, based on the finite element method, this paper proposes a cable support system for the construction of assembled steel structure composite floor. Through the simulation of the material nonlinearity and structural nonlinearity of the composite slab in the whole construction process, the influence of the parameters such as the cross-sectional area of the cable, the initial tensile stress, the thickness of the gasket and the cross-sectional area on the structural performance is studied. The unit load stress, strain cloud map, key node load-vertical displacement curve. The results show that increasing the initial tensile stress of the cable can effectively improve the initial stiffness of the structure. Reducing the cross-sectional area of the cable is an effective method to reduce the structural deflection, improve the initial stiffness and delay the initial stiffness degradation. It is recommended that the ratio of the initial tensile stress to the ultimate strength of the cable is not greater than 0.4, and the lightweight material gasket is preferentially selected.

articleTitle: Quadrotor Aircraft Control Strategy Based on Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Quadrotor aircraft has the characteristics of nonlinear time-varying and strong coupling that makes it difficult to control. To solve these problems, a control strategy based on fuzzy PID was proposed. By the strategy, the fuzzy PID control algorithm is combined with the established dynamic model of the quadrotor aircraft. Under the MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment, the traditional PID control algorithms are used as comparison algorithms with human interference factors considered to validate the fuzzy PID controller. Human interference factors are added to them at the same time, many experiments have been carried out by simulation. The results of simulation show that the quadrotor aircraft controlled by fuzzy PID has good track tracking ability and stronger anti-interference ability and the control effect is better than the comparison algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cruise Ship Supply Chain Cooperation Model Selection and Price Decision Based on Network Externality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Under the background that the domestic cruise market is exclusively sold by travel agencies, this paper studies the influence of network externalities on the profit of each main body of the cruise travel supply chain, the price of tickets, the sales effort of travel agencies, etc., and then discusses the coordination mechanism and price decision between cruise companies and travel. In this paper, it is assumed that a cruise company and a travel agency constitute the cruise tourism supply chain, and the Stackelberg master-slave game model is constructed to study the supply chain decision equilibrium solution under the existence of network externalities, charter ship mode, commission mode, and centralized decision mode. The results show that: (1) With the enhancement of network externality, the selling price of ferry tickets and the sales effort of travel agencies are improved. (2) The profit of cruise companies, travel agencies, and even the total profit of the entire cruise travel supply chain increases with the enhancement of network externality. The research results can provide a theoretical reference for cruise companies and travel agencies when choosing cooperation mode and making ticket price decisions when network externalities change.

articleTitle: Study of Die-Nesting Process for Automotive Coverings by CAE
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: A method to reduce the cost of automotive coverings was introduced. That was, the die-nesting process was used, nest a small parts in the scrap area of a big part, and a virtual die trial was made with the help of CAE simulation technology, to achieve savings in tooling costs, stamping costs, and to improved material utilization which significantly reduces part cost. Took The application of the die-nesting process of a panel-tailgate-outer and a panel-reinforce-hoodlock-upper of a SUV as an example to illustrate the realization of the die-nesting process and the actual effect of reducing the cost of parts, thus confirming that the method was an effective way to reduce the cost of automotive coverings.

articleTitle: Measuring Algorithm for Contact Wire Geometric Parameter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The geometric parameters of the contact wire directly affect the electrified railway. To lengthen the operation life of the pantograph, there is an urgent demand to measure the parameters of contact wires. This paper proposes a measuring algorithm for the geometry parameter of the contact wire. With the establishment of triangular coordinates, we propose a measurement procedure to calculate parameters and analyze random and systematic errors. With this measurement, we hope to help extend the life of the pantograph.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis and Applicability Study of Rigid Frame System of Segmental Assembled Box Girder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Segmental assembled box girder has the characteristics of fast construction progress, small environmental interference, industrialized construction, and reduction of life cycle cost. The rigid structure system has the advantages of no bearing, good seismic performance, and easy maintenance. The rigid structure system of segmental assembled box girder takes into account the above advantages. However, the reasonable application of this type of bridge lacks detailed research. Taking the ji-he reconstruction and expansion project as the background project, closely following the prefabricated assembly, this paper introduces the application examples of this new structure in the urban expressway, including the selection of standard sections, the configuration of ordinary reinforcement and prestressed tendons, the shear key structure, the temporary preloading device design of hoisting, and the prefabricated pier structure. A segment assembly method of full cantilever is recommended, and the control value of theoretical calculation is given through finite element analysis and calculation.

articleTitle: A Method of Topology Obfuscation Based on Adding Virtual Nodes and Links
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The protection of critical information infrastructure is the forefront of the current cyber space security research. This paper first introduces the concept and common methods of topological inference and topological obfuscation. Then, an improved topological obfuscation method based on adding virtual nodes and links is proposed for active topological inference represented by traceroute. It improves the deployment node selection algorithm and adds virtual nodes and links by replicating the key topologies of the real network. For an attacker using traceroute for topology inference, this approach can mislead them into getting the wrong order of node importance. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed topological obfuscation method can effectively combat the active topological reasoning in the typical star topology network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Inventory Management Information System for Resource-Based Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, an inventory management information system has been developed by employing the robust database operation characteristics and technology of Delphi7.0. Inventory management in the resource-based enterprises is a time-consuming and complicated task that requires daily dealing with a large amount of document data. It is a critical research field for achieving the informatization, intellectualization, and scientificization of inventory management in the resource-based enterprises. We have optimized the inventory management in response to the existing problems of the resource-based enterprises. Such an optimized system satisfactorily meets the needs of the resource-based enterprises in the inventory information management, thus effectively improving the warehouse management efficiency and promoting a high-quality enterprise development, besides having certain specific economic and social values.

articleTitle: The Impact of Ambidextrous Learning on Organizational Routines with Environmental Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Organizational routines are important ways for enterprises to optimize their organization and adapt to external environments. In complex and dynamic environments, it is crucial to select appropriate strategies for the evolution of organizational routines. This paper divides environmental uncertainty into two dimensions: complexity and dynamism, and further refines it into four different environmental states. Based on simulation research using the NK model, this study investigates the applicability of exploitation, exploration, and balanced learning strategies in these four environmental states. The results show that exploitation is recognized as a more suitable strategy in simple stable and simple dynamic environments, while a balanced learning strategy fits better in complex stable environments. In complex dynamic environments, an exploration strategy should be adopted.

articleTitle: The Application of Graphene in the Field of Electronics and Electricity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Since its discovery, graphene has attracted widespread interest as a two-dimensional material composed of carbon atoms. It has a unique lattice structure and excellent properties, including high electrical conductivity, excellent carrier mobility, outstanding optoelectronic properties, excellent mechanical properties, chemical stability, and thermal conductivity. This makes graphene a great potential in the field of electrical and electronic devices. Graphene can be used in high-speed electronic devices, high-performance transistors, flexible displays, solar cells, photo detectors, and light sensors. This paper introduces the structure, properties, preparation, and characterization methods of graphene and its application in electrical and electronic fields, and summarizes its application potential and challenges in this field. All in all, graphene, as a material with unique properties, has broad application potential in the field of electronic and electrical devices and provides new opportunities for the development of electronic technology.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration and Noise Control Technology of Propeller-Shaft-Hull Coupled System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to improve the comfort of the ship and reduce interference with the hull and measurement equipment, the design and optimization of low noise ships have important engineering significance. Broadband pulsating propulsion force generated by the propeller is a major source of excitation for ship vibration. The problem of ship vibration and radiation noise caused by the excitation force of the propeller through the propulsion shaft system and bearing support needs to comprehensively consider the coupled characteristics of the propeller-shaft system foundation. The paper analyses the vibration transmission mechanism of coupled system, and provide a theoretical basis for effectively controlling the vibration and sound radiation of the ship. Therefore, it is crucial to conduct research on vibration and noise control technology caused by propeller-shaft-hull coupled system.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Pile Construction Technology Based on Dynamo Plug-In Secondary Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Research on the rapid modeling software of engineering piles based on BIM technology; By using Revit secondary development plug-in and Dynamo, geological exploration data and pile foundation design parameters are extracted and parameterized modeling is completed. Automatic calculation, verification and adjustment of pile length are completed. BIM model data is imported into the independently developed Mysql database of pile foundation construction management, and on-site managers log in the pile foundation construction management system on mobile terminals. Retrieve and obtain design parameter information of engineering pile, fill in site construction data of engineering pile, assist site construction, test and acceptance data management.

articleTitle: Research On Eenergy Feedback Type AC Electronic Load
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The study of AC electronic load for student learning and power testing proposed an energy feedback type AC electronic load. Energy feedback single phase AC electronic load is a power electronic device which can simulate resistive load and inductive and capacitive load of any power factor and return the absorbed energy to the power grid. The main circuit topology adopts AC/DC/AC structure, the former load characteristic simulation unit adopts the current loop closed-loop control, the latter stage energy feedback unit adopts the double closed-loop grid-connected control algorithm, and the main circuit rectifier and inverter adopt the unipolar PWM modulation scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Resources Optimization Allocation Under Emergency Events
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper proposes three kinds of optimal allocation of regional logistics resources under emergencies. They are direct path configuration strategy, core area distribution node configuration strategy and hybrid adjustment configuration strategy. Taking the adjustment strategy of regional logistics resources into full consideration, and aiming at the shortest total transportation time, the optimal allocation model of regional logistics resources under emergencies is constructed; Combined with the characteristics of the model decision variables, the improved immune clone algorithm is used to solve the problem, and an example is verified. The results show that the model and algorithm have good adaptability.

articleTitle: Poisoning Attack in Federated Learning Using Normalizing Flows
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Federated learning can effectively solve the “isolated data island” problem but is vulnerable to poisoning attacks, mainly including backdoor attack and label-flipping attack. The backdoor attack needs to modify the input samples, which is impractical. The label-flipping attack is simple, and there is still room for improvement in the attack effect. Therefore, we propose a method to generate poisoned samples for the targeted attack using normalizing flows (SniperFlow) and apply it in the poisoning attacks in federated learning (NFPA). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that explores the use of normalizing flows in the poisoning Attack in federated learning. And the experiments prove that our method has outstanding attack performance, better than the label-flipping attack at the accuracy of the target task.

articleTitle: Optimization of Electrolytic Aluminum Production Process by Intelligent Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Electrolytic aluminum is an industry with high energy consumption and high pollution, and it faces many difficulties and challenges to realize intelligent control. In order to solve the above problems, this paper expounds the current development status of intelligent control of electrolytic aluminum process, the composition of intelligent control optimization process system of electrolytic aluminum, the intelligent control optimization measures of electrolytic aluminum enterprises, and looks forward to the development prospect of intelligent control optimization of electrolytic aluminum.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Video Users' Purchase Intention of Advance On-Demand Based on Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the continuous iterative upgrading of the online video industry, more and more video content needs to be purchased. The profit model of the video industry has shifted from a single advertising revenue to diversification. The advanced on-demand model is a newly derived profit model. From the perspective of video users, this paper takes the adoption model based on perceived value as the theoretical basis. Combined with relevant literature and the actual situation of video users' advance on-demand, seven variables, namely perceived value, perceived risk, purchase cost, perceived entertainment, perceived usefulness, social impact, and purchase intention, are selected to construct a research model of the influencing factors of video users' advanced on-demand purchase intention. After the analysis of reliability, validity, and structural equation, it is concluded that perceived value and social impact have a significant positive impact on video users' purchase intention of advance on-demand. Thus, providing reasonable operational suggestions for video operators.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of PSO Optimization Technology Integration in Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article proposes a data analysis algorithm for an improved and optimized PSO model to analyze the optimization process of talent cultivation. By combining multiple operators with Standard PSO, the search ability and accuracy of PSO have been improved. Applying this technology to the strategic analysis of talent cultivation through deep integration of digital media technology, the important role of technology in teaching is identified, thus determining the advantages and characteristics of digital media technology in talent cultivation. The experimental results indicate that using the PSO optimization model can accurately analyze the demand for digital media technology in talent in the field. Through PSO big data analysis, reliable basis can be provided for teaching analysis and talent cultivation.

articleTitle: Progress of Application of Digital Image Correlation Method (DIC) in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Digital Image Correlation Method (DIC), also known as Digital Speckle Correlation (DSC), is an optical measurement method that uses computer vision technology to identify and calculate the probability statistical correlation of randomly distributed speckle features on the surface of an object before and after deformation, in order to determine the displacement or deformation of the object.
