Digital image correlation method is a modern full field optical measurement technology with the characteristics of non-contact and non interference, which has been widely applied in fields such as aerospace, civil engineering measurement, and object deformation monitoring. This article elaborates on the development process of digital image related technologies and their applications in the field of civil engineering. This technology has a simpler operating process, can be applied to a wider range of usage environments, and achieves higher accuracy. Therefore, its application in the field of civil engineering is becoming increasingly common.

articleTitle: Quantity Prediction of nuclear weapons Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The emergence of nuclear weapons is the result of major developments in science and technology around the 1940s. The number of nuclear weapons possessed by each country affects the shape of the world. In order to predict the number of countries possessing nuclear weapons 100 years later, we set up the stochastic forest regression prediction model, which is completed in three parts: the model principle, the model training process and the model results. In the model training, the reference adjustment process is fully demonstrated. With the help of computer simulation, the number of countries possessing nuclear weapons in 2123 is 15. At the same time, four loss functions, MSE, MAE, RMSE and SMAPE, were set up to evaluate the predicted results.

articleTitle: Some Explorations Based on the Application of BIM Technology in Housing Construction Project Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In recent years, the construction industry has gradually become an important industry in the development of national economy, and housing construction projects occupy a large proportion in the construction industry. Building construction projects have high requirements for the application of building information modeling (BIM), and the application of building information modeling technology assists housing construction project management to improve project management and make the model innovation of project management possible. The article analyzes the application of BIM technology in each stage of housing construction project management, discusses the selection and application of BIM technology, and proposes development measures, so as to provide some ideas for the application of BIM technology in housing construction project management.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Instant Messaging Service System for Internet Enterprises Based on Hierarchical Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of serious information leakage and high control difficulty in the instant messaging service system of Internet enterprises, this paper designs a hierarchical protection instant messaging service system, analyzes the software architecture around identity authentication, notification service, message service and file service, and constructs a hierarchical protection system of instant messaging service system. Finally, the system implementation is analyzed for important modules. The overall performance of the communication system is good, and the information security, protection and controllability are remarkable, which can meet the development needs of Internet enterprises, and make sure they can provide excellent service.

articleTitle: Short-Term Prediction of PM2.5 Concentration based on Self-Attention Mechanism Improved Temporal Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: PM2.5 is the key to air pollution and is closely related to residents' health. The change of PM2.5 concentration is affected by pollutant factors, meteorological factors, time factors and spatial factors, and the change range is great and has significant uncertainty. Therefore, this paper uses Copula entropy to screen the indicators used to predict PM2.5, and proposes a self-attention mechanism improved temporal convolution network (TCNA) to predict PM2.5 concentration. Firstly, Copula entropy studies the correlation between PM2.5 concentration and various influencing factors and selects the main influencing factors. Then, the convolution structure of TCN extracts the relation of time dependence, and then the self-attention mechanism focuses on the features of internal correlation to achieve accurate hourly prediction of PM2.5 concentration. To verify the validity of the model, this paper predicts PM2.5 concentration based on the hourly meteorological and pollutant concentration data of 12 regions in Beijing from 2013 to 2017. The results show that the model shows high interpretability and accuracy in predicting hourly PM2.5 concentration, and R2 is as high as 99.26 %. Compared with the TCN model, MAPE was reduced by 24.23 %.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Architecture of Construction Project Management System Based on BIM Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Catalyzed by the rapid development of the economy and technology, the scale and complexity of construction engineering projects are growing day by day. Traditional construction project management, however, cannot meet contemporary needs. Therefore, there is an urgent need to increase the level of informatization development in construction project management. Against this background, this study analyzes the current application of building information model (BIM) and cloud computing in construction project management systems. We design the construction project management system architecture based on the BIM cloud platform, which includes six layers of the structure and covers all the processes involved in construction project management. It is meaningful for improving the efficiency of construction project management with reference meaning.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multimodal Transportation Path for Fresh Agricultural Products Considering Unexpected Factors and Transfer Frequency Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the transportation cost and time of fresh agricultural products increase due to unexpected factors and transfer frequency constraints, an optimization model of transportation cost and transportation time is established. The new model is solved by using improved genetic algorithm, the optimal route of fresh agricultural products transportation is obtained, which provides a theoretical basis for the multimodal transportation route decision-making problem of enterprises. Firstly, the mathematical models of minimum transportation cost and minimum transportation time are established. Then the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the example, and the optimal route of multimodal transportation is obtained. The results of the optimal route are compared with those of the other two routes. The results show that the optimal route has the minimum transportation cost and the shortest time. The model can effectively reduce the risk caused by unexpected factors and transfer frequency constraints, and provide a low-cost, high-efficiency transport strategy for logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: A Study on Penetration Technology of Breaking the Wall by Detonating Cord
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the fight against terrorism in cities, terrorists often confront with rescuers for a long time by taking hostages and relying on building walls as barriers. Bursting method can be used as an effective way for wall breaking. According to the requirements of wall penetration, this thesis use a kind of simple charge made by detonating cord to blast the wall. The blasting effect is simulated by AUTODYN and verified by experiments. This research can be used as a reference for the special police unit to carry out anti-terrorism operations.

articleTitle: Research on Laboratory Crowd Evacuation Model Considering Environmental Familiarity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to study the impact of environmental familiarity on laboratory crowd evacuation, a pedestrian lattice gas model considering environmental familiarity was established. The model introduces an environmental familiarity parameter to simulate pedestrian familiarity with the laboratory environment. This article takes a chemistry laboratory in a university as an example to study the impact of environmental familiarity on pedestrian evacuation efficiency. The results show that pedestrian evacuation time decreases with increasing familiarity with the environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Underwater Robot Integrated Operation Vehicle in the Scene of Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the proposal of “Double Carbon Target”, the frequency of use of hydropower stations and the quality requirements of operation and maintenance have been further improved, which has stimulated the development and application of underwater detection technology. At present, underwater detection technology in the complex environment of hydropower stations has high requirements for the transportation, hoisting, shore-based power supply, and overall control of underwater robots, and requires additional manpower and technical support. Therefore, it is necessary to use an integrated operation vehicle to optimize the overall workflow of underwater detection. This paper studies the demand and application status of the integrated underwater robot vehicle, and combines the artificial intelligence technology to explain the key functions and research points of the lifting design, image classification and recognition of the integrated vehicle.

articleTitle: Design of Equivalent Simulation System for Internal Combustion Engine Based on Servo Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The equivalent simulation system can effectively solve the problems of complex test process, long period and high cost of the traditional original machine bench test. This paper takes the single-cylinder internal combustion engine as the research object, and proposes an equivalent simulation system. The system uses the servo motor as the power source, designs the active loading mechanism and combines the double-headed cylinder to equivalent the working load of the cylinder. The load acts on the equivalent piston end of the center crank connecting rod mechanism, which is equivalently designed by similar principles, and through the joint simulation of Adams and Simulink, the equivalent simulation of the kinematics and dynamic characteristics of the single-cylinder engine is realized.

articleTitle: Online Ultra-Short-Term Wind Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Ultra-short-term wind power prediction (UST WPP) is the key technique to guide the Power Grid to make planned dispatching for electricity on a daily basis and to maintain a steady operation for electricity trading market. Due to the fluctuating and intermittent characteristics of wind speed, the forecasting wind speed from numerical weather prediction (NWP) has large deviations from real wind speed, and it is difficult to meet the high demande of for UST WPP accuracy. To address this problem, this paper proposes an online wind speed revision model based on Kalman filter (KF) and multiple meteorological sources, and builds a wind-power conversion model based on light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) algorithm to accelerate the calculating speed and to improve the accuracy of UST WPP. Based on the data analysis of a costal wind farm in Zhejiang province, the wind speed data after the revision of KF can effectively reflect the trend of real wind speed, so that the mean absolute error decreases dramatically. After inputting the revised wind speed into LightGBM model, the obtainted UST WPP gets very close to real power such that the root mean square error decrease from 16.36% to 5.64% after revision of KF, which means UST WPP accuracy improves effectively.

articleTitle: Research on an Automatic Cleaning Device for Weights Based on Ultrasonic Cleaning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In modern quality measurement, weights are standard measuring tools for transmitting mass values, and their quality is affected by the usage environment. Therefore, before calibration and measurement, it is necessary to clean the weights to ensure the reliability of the measurement results. At present, the laboratory generally uses anhydrous ethanol to clean weights manually, but the number of weights sent for inspection is large, the cleaning time is long, the work efficiency is low, and ethanol has certain risks. In order to solve practical work problems, this article studies a weight automatic cleaning device suitable for class F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> milligram and gram weight cleaning based on ultrasonic cleaning technology. After using this device, it is expected that the cleaning time for a set of 1mg~500g weights can be reduced by about 50%, which can effectively reduce the labor intensity of the operator, shorten the cleaning time, avoid environmental pollution, and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Control of Anti-Explosive Terrorist Attack Capability Based on Fuzzy-ANP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: ANP method is used to construct the anti-explosive terrorist attack capability evaluation system and calculation model. Membership degree theory and fuzzy operator are used to quantitatively solve the calculation model, and the weight and interdependence of each index are calculated. Based on the calculation results, the shortcomings of anti-explosive terrorist attack are retrospectively analyzed and suggestions for improvement are put forward. The relevant research conclusions are of reference significance to the improvement of anti-explosive terrorist attack capability of blasting company and the theoretical construction of anti-terrorist operation.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Teaching and Research Group System Based on Micro-service and Micro-application under Background of Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Smart campus is the inevitable trend of information construction in universities. The research is based on the structure of one-stop online service hall for local smart campus, from the perspective of micro-service and micro-application, this study is devoted to developing and releasing a teaching and research group system for end user side rapidly by agile model of Scrum. The paper describes a feasible development process of the first Sprint for Scrum, which functionality modules of member management, daily teaching management, teaching and research activity management of the system are implemented positively. In the end, further work of visualization management is put forward, which should be constructed and reflected in one-stop online service hall for application components for service in smart campus.

articleTitle: CAE-Based Case of Improving Material Utilization of Body Sheet Metal Parts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Improving the material utilization rate of body sheet metal parts can significantly reduce the cost of parts and improve the competitiveness of products. This paper introduces a method to improve material utilization rate of body sheet metal parts, through which cost control can be achieved. The method is based on the CAE of sheet metal forming at the early stage of design, using the techniques of part boundary adjustment, process residual meat surface optimization and automatic sample arrangement that come with mature softwares, and combining with the experience accumulated in the actual production process, the optimal part state and process scheme are finally obtained to achieve the maximum material utilization rate. Taking the rear wheel arc lower trim part of vehicle A as a case, the material utilization rate increased from 40.2% at the beginning to 49.8% after adopting the method, saving 0.11 kg of material per vehicle and $0.7 in material cost, which proved that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Application of Copula Function in Shanghai and Shenzhen Index
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: For the description of the correlation between the Shanghai index return rate and the Shenzhen's, the copula model is selected between the normal copula function and the t-copula function. The results show that the binary t-copula with linear correlation coefficient of 0.9289 and degree of freedom of 4 is closer to the sample correlation coefficient; Kendall rank correlation coefficient and Spearman rank correlation coefficient of normal copula are closer to the sample.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Sensor Internet of Things Throughput Maximization Relay Node Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The relay node is the transit center of the sensor Internet of Things communication, and the rationality of its selection is of great significance to ensure the stability of the Internet of Things communication and information throughput. This paper proposes a method of selecting relay nodes based on optical fiber to maximize the throughput of the sensing Internet of Things. By building a sensor Internet of Things model, find the main lobe in the target fiber sensor base station, and identify the signal transmitted by the light source node. Select the relay nodes that can transmit the known optical channel status to other nodes in the candidate nodes, remove the nodes that cannot maximize the throughput, obtain the average received signal to noise ratio of the sensor Internet of Things based on statistical independent distribution, and select the appropriate fiber sensor antenna to complete the relay node selection. Simulation results show that the outage probability of the proposed method approaches zero when the number of nodes is 22;When the power of the light source node is 30 dBm, the network throughput reaches 98%.

Author Keywords: optical fiber sensor;Internet of Things technology;Relay node selection;Network throughput

articleTitle: Development of Data Analysis and Dump System for Harmonious High-power Diesel Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The fault rate of heavy-load diesel locomotives in Northeast China is high. The locomotive status is reflected by the data such as fan current, diesel injection rate and turbocharger revolution. The data before the fault occurring can not be recorded in case of failing, which causing by fault analysis and failure location. The data analysis and dump system solving the problem of fault analysis and fault location which included locomotive data acquisition and transmission device and application software is studied and researched in this paper. Effective data support for locomotive fault analysis can be provided by this system and reasonable judgments and propose accurate solutions can be given.

articleTitle: The Application of AI Speech Evaluation Technology in College English Teaching under the Smart Classroom Teaching Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Spoken English proficiency is an important manifestation of college students' comprehensive English ability, and it is also an inevitable requirement for college students when adapting to the current globalization. However, due to the the particularity of spoken English and the lack of teaching efficiency, it increases the difficulty for students to improve their spoken English proficiency, and also makes it a difficult point in language teaching for teachers. Aiming at these problems, a college English smart classroom teaching model is constructed based on the iFlytek FiF Spoken English Training System. This system employs AI speech evaluation technology, which relying on Deep Neural Network Model. A teaching quasi-experiment have been carried out for one semester among undergraduates. The research findings have shown that the application of AI Speech Evaluation Technology in college English teaching can improve students' participation in learning and teaching efficiency dramatically.

Author Keywords: The iFlytek FiF Spoken English Training System

articleTitle: Study on Overlying Strata Movement Law of Shortwall Fully-Mechanized Working Face with Different Sizes of Remnant Pillar Based on 3DEC Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Based on 3DEC simulation software, the numerical model of remnant pillar resource recovery was established, and the overlying strata movement law of different sizes of remnant pillar in shortwall fully-mechanized working face was analyzed. The results show that the influence on the overlying strata of the “coal face of adjacent goaf” gradually decreases with the increase of the size of the remnant pillar, which is similar with the overlying strata displacement of the “coal face of facing goaf” working face. The vertical displacement distribution of the coal pillar is small at both ends and large in the middle. The horizontal displacement of overlying strata in “coal face of surrounding goaf” working face is concentrated in 20 m coal pillar, which is more vulnerable to the influence of goaf. With the increase of the angle between the goaf and the working face, the effective length of the “coal face of through empty roadway” roadway decreases significantly, and the open leakage area of the roof also decreases, leading to the roof subsidence of the goaf increases.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Research of the Integrated Operation Vehicle of Underwater Robot Equipment Based on the Field Application of Long Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Underwater tunnel detection is a detection method for the observation and prevention of water conservancy and hydropower projects and provides an important reference for the next step of hydropower generation. When the underwater robot enters the tunnel inspection site for layout, it needs to second or rent a crane, and the underwater robot does not have high requirements for lifting itself. The purpose of researching the underwater robot integrated operation vehicle is to meet the inspection of hydropower station tunnels, facilitate site layout and construction, so as to save site layout time, improve operation safety factor, and save construction period costs.

articleTitle: Batch and Lossless Image Hiding Via Super Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Batch image hiding refers to the technique of embedding and extracting multiple secret images within a cover image in a covert manner. This process is typically used in applications that require the secure transmission of multiple secret images over a public channel while keeping the sensitive information hidden from unauthorized viewers. However, existing batch image steganography methods prioritize the visual effect of the resulting “stego” images over the constraint of lossless extraction of secret images, and often sacrifice detection resistance. In this paper, we propose a new steganography framework that can embed batch images into images and extract them without loss, thus overcoming the aforementioned challenges in image hiding. To achieve lossless data revealing, we formulate the data hiding as an image super-resolution problem. We consider the cover image as the object of the super-resolution process, while the batch secret images are mapped as the high-frequency information of the super-resolution images. Additionally, we design an invertible neural network that simultaneously learns the super-resolution process and the corresponding inverse transformation, enabling the lossless extraction of secret images. Finally, through qualitative and quantitative experiments and analysis, we demonstrate that our method achieves 100% revealing accuracy in different scenarios and is resistant to third-party detection.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Stamping Process Design of Automobile Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In view of the pain points of complex stamping forming problems of automobile panels, multiple and complex processes, high quality requirements, long talent training cycle, difficult knowledge accumulation, and difficult knowledge reuse, a new method is proposed: through the study of stamping theoretical rules and the laws of flanging crack limit of a large number of parts, a parametric model is established based on CATIA, and an expert database of input parameters is established, Based on C++, a rule query program for technologists is made, and artificial intelligence technology is used to provide intelligent and constructive design assistance for stamping professional designers. Different from traditional programs, it simulates the thinking process of experts and uses knowledge to infer results.

articleTitle: An Open Domain Event Extraction Method for News Clusters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Open domain event extraction aims to extract events from news clusters on the background of non-predefined event types. However, such methods usually have insufficient feature vector extraction in the pretraining stage and the high cluster embedding dimension affects the task performance. To address these problems, we propose to use BERT to pre-train at the encoding layer to obtain a rich representation of the contextual feature sequence, and then dimensionality reduction of the embedding vector to obtain local and global features. In addition, to further focus on key information, we also introduce a self-attention mechanism to implement different weight assignments for feature learning. Experiments on the datasets demonstrated that our approach is effective for news cluster event extraction tasks in open domains.

articleTitle: Research on Data Enhancement of Rolling Bearings Based on His-VAEGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Due to the poor working conditions of diesel generators and the precise structural characteristics and installation positions of rolling bearings, it is difficult to collect vibration samples to a great extent, resulting in the insufficiency and imbalance of sample data used for feature analysis. This paper proposes a method based on energy histogram optimization of Variational Autoencoding Generate Adversarial Network (VAEGAN) to expand sample data set. Specifically, on the basis of the classic VAEGAN, adding the classification to the generator (VAE) to improve and enhance the category attributes of the generated samples. Then, drawing the energy histogram of the real and generated samples, and using the non-intersection core of the energy histogram to update the network to improve the quality of signal generation. Through experiments and index analysis, the effectiveness of the algorithm for sample generation is verified.

articleTitle: Research on the New Trend of Power Grid Construction Cost Management Under the Background of Economic System Reform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, faced with downward economic pressure, power grid enterprises are seriously influenced. In addition, profit margins are further compressed, benefits of power grid enterprises investment become the focus of attention. Because the investment of power grid construction is huge. Power grid construction is the key of investment. Scientific management of construction funds and optimizing power grid project cost management are very important. This paper created a new trend of power grid construction cost management under the situation of development. The cost management was an important method of improving the economic and social benefits of the power grid construction project at the same time. A complete set of advanced and scientific cost management system has been developed, and tentatively promoted and implemented in the cost management of power grid construction.

articleTitle: Driver Facial Expression Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article compares traditional facial expression recognition methods with deep learning methods for facial expression recognition. The proposed deep learning method is feasible. Based on the theoretical knowledge of convolutional neural networks, a facial expression recognition system is developed with static facial expression recognition function

articleTitle: Research on Fast Detection and Crack Identification Algorithm of Highway Pavement Based on Feature Space
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Due to the diversity and uncertainty of highway pavement cracks and the unavoidable noise interference, the collected highway pavement images contain a lot of information about pavement lines, pedestrians and trees, which further makes it more difficult to detect and identify highway pavement cracks, resulting in problems such as low accuracy of crack measurement and low work efficiency. Based on this, this paper is devoted to the study of highway pavement crack detection technology to analyze the phenomenon of highway pavement damage. In order to achieve this goal, this paper proposes a fast detection and crack identification algorithm for highway pavement based on feature space, in order to provide a new method for highway pavement crack detection.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on no Position Control Strategy of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on On-Line Training of BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: For the rotor position estimation model of switched reluctance motor position free control system, This paper presents an online training rotor position identification method based on BP neural network. By generating the M program of neural network, dynamically extracting the training samples, batch training the neural network, and finally obtain the accurate estimation of rotor position and angle. The simulation results show that under different working conditions, the error between the actual rotor position and the estimated rotor position of the system is small, the estimated rotor position angle accuracy is high, and has good dynamic response ability, so as to realize the accurate control of switched reluctance without position.

articleTitle: The Current Situation and Trend of International Trade Statistics Based on Internet Data and Statistical Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The development of international trade (IT) has brought the continuous inflow of foreign capital and further stimulated economic growth (EG). This paper obtains the trade growth data of some regions in China in the past five years to analyze the trend of international trade. And we use trade gravity models to quantify the study of trade between countries. Then from two perspectives of capital mechanism and institutional elements, we conduct empirical analysis of IT to promote EG. We investigate the changes in the effects between the variables and economic growth by building a regression model and solving for each parameter of the model based on measured data, and then evaluating whether the regression model fits the data well. Finally, we draw the conclusion that for every 1% growth of foreign trade volume, the economic gross product increases by about 0.70%. Hence, the trade growth situation has a positive influence on promoting economic development.

articleTitle: A Neighborhood Decision Based Mean Filter for Video Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Denoising Gaussian noise generated in digital images during acquisition and transmission requires balancing the denoising effect with the loss of picture details, and existing spatial domain filtering methods have their advantages and disadvantages. In this work, we propose an improved method based on mean filtering, which uses a depth-first search algorithm to find connected blocks with similar colors to the center point of the current filter window, and only counts the values of these pixel points for the filtering operation. This method improves the inherent defects of mean filtering by considering the correlation of colors between pixel points. Moreover, we conducted an experimental design considering the acceptance characteristics of film and television viewers. The quantitative and qualitative results of the experiments show that our method has certain advantages in preserving the edge clarity of color blocks and the sharpness of the image when applied to the noise reduction of film and television image frames.

articleTitle: C-YOLOX: Improved YOLOX Model for Tomato Diseased Leaves Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Different tomato growing stages are more likely to experience tomato diseases, and manual diagnosis requires a lot of work. To address the artificial recognition method's high rate of mistakes and poor accuracy, We proposed an improved C-YOLOX model built on the YOLOX-S model and applied it to healthy tomato leaves and 9 different tomato species Leaf diseases for training and identification. Firstly, we close the data augmentation in the last ⌊total epochs * 0. 25⌋ epochs to avoid the over-fitting problem. Secondly, the YOLOX-S model is further enhanced by adding a Coordinate attention mechanism module to the backbone network to better extract image feature information. Finally, we replace the silu activation function with the hard swish activation function to reduce computational costs. The experiments show that the revised C-YOLOX algorithm's best mAP50_95 value was 84.42%, 4.09 percentage points higher than it was before the change, demonstrating its efficacy. The upgraded C-YOLOX algorithm performs better.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Gel Material Handling Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Gel materials have large softness and high surface tackiness, and there are problems such as difficult handling in automated production. In this paper, a set of suction cup manipulator with both blowing and suction is designed for the handling of gel materials. The main body of the manipulator is composed of three synchronous belt linear motion modules, and the end grabbing mechanism adopts a gas nozzle. This paper calculates the actual requirements of the required I/O port, and finally determines the selection of PLC as FX3U-24MT. The overall program of PLC is divided into manual control program and automatic control program, using touch screen for human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: A Study on the Morphological Changes of Power Grid Project Construction Scale Prediction in the Post-Epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper began with the impact of COVID-19 on China's domestic economy economic growth momentum, analyses the influences of consumption, investment, import and export. And then the paper explored the relationship between economic growth momentum and power grid project construction requirements. Based on research results, the paper made a clear the current situation and demand for electricity in China. This paper analyses the trend of domestic power project construction requirements in the post-COVID-19 era from the perspectives of electricity consumption, load characteristics and industrial structure of the whole society. The findings are as follows: (1) Domestic consumption has a large volume, a fast changing trend, a high contribution rate to economic growth, a small contribution to the growth of electricity consumption, but an obvious effect on load; (2) Investment is still one of the driving forces of economic growth, and fixed asset investment has a significant amplification effect on power project construction requirements; (3) Import and export trade is directly related to domestic power project construction requirements through the secondary industry, and has a certain positive effect.

articleTitle: A Study on Spectral Characteristics of Star-Shaped Nanoparticles Based on the Finite Element Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With strong surface plasmon characteristics, star-shaped nanoparticles are widely applied in the fields of Raman test, photovoltaic efficiency enhancement and refractive index sensing. In this paper, the spectral characteristics of star-shaped nanoparticles with different morphologies are studied with the finite element numerical calculation method. The results show that star-shaped nanoparticles have stronger surface plasmon characteristics than spherical nanoparticles; The wavelength position and intensity corresponding to the surface plasmon resonance peak of gold nanostars are closely related to the core size, branch angle length and sharpness angle of star-shaped nanoparticles. The larger the core, the longer the branch angle length, and the sharper the tip are, the stronger the surface plasmon effect will be. When the nanostars form a chain structure, the surface plasmon resonance effect is more intense, which can enhance the electric field strength by 7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>times. These findings provide theoretical basis for the application of star-shaped nanoparticles.

articleTitle: The Satisfaction Improvement Strategy of Green Development Based on the AHP-entropy Weight Method and CART Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this study, the AHP-entropy weight method is used to weigh various indicators that affect green development, establish urban green development evaluation indicators, and then explore the important factors that affect people's satisfaction with green development through the Classification Regression Tree algorithm. Finally, a prediction model is established. It was found that the classification and regression model prediction results of the CART algorithm have high accuracy. The city's green coverage area indicator is the most important indicator through the AHP-entropy weight method. By using the CART algorithm, the most important factors affecting citizens' satisfaction with the green development of Xiamen City are the actions of the municipal government. Based on the research results, an improvement strategy for green development satisfaction in Xiamen is proposed.

articleTitle: Improved Object Detectors Based on Semantic Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Object detection methods generally use fused features for box regression and category classification, but shallow fused features lack long-distance contextual information. To address the above issues, we propose an embeddable semantic feature fusion network called UN eck that extracts global information from deep features and iteratively fuses shallow features to improve the performance of the object detectors.

articleTitle: Study on Reservoir Characteristics Based on Deep Lateral Resistivity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Reservoir evaluation requires the study of various reservoir characteristics. Different rocks, oil and water in nature have different conductivity. After electrifying the rocks, logging curves such as spontaneous potential, deep lateral resistivity and so on can be obtained. Standardizing and analyzing the logging curves can identify the oil-bearing property and lithology of the reservoir more accurately. It can be known that the main lithology in this area are siltstone, sandy conglomerate and coarse sandstone. The average porosity of the reservoir is 8.2% and the average permeability is 0.6mD. The cores are oil spots, oil immersion, oil stains and rich in oil. The lower limit of sandstone resistivity range is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$15\Omega\cdot \mathrm{m}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Fast Collision Detection Technology of Group Animation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Presents a collision detection algorithm which can quickly determine the location of primitives in group animation. The convex hull algorithm of space geometry is established by using the sphere mixture hulling technique based on spatial geometry model in complex scenes, and the sphere mixture reconstruction is transformed into line body mixture reconstruction to deal with non-convex process. The reality of virtual object is enhanced and the distortion of virtual object surface is avoided. The experimental results show that it has some advantages compared with the classical algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Denoising Algorithm in Monthly Runoff Series of Fuchun River Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the continuous development of human society and economy, human demand for electricity is increasing. Hydropower is one of the main sources of power supply. However, the amount of hydropower generation is affected by the upstream runoff. However, the prediction accuracy of runoff has always been a difficult problem in the scientific community. Due to the existence of many tributaries and the influence of human activities, there is more or less noise in the runoff of natural river. The existence of these noises masks the real characteristics of runoff. In order to get the real characteristics of runoff, this paper applies the Wavelet Denoising Algorithm to the denoising of runoff series. The runoff series is denoised by selecting appropriate wavelet function, multi-resolution decomposition layers and threshold quantization method. The denoising effect is determined by calculating the amount of information contained in the runoff sequence before and after denoising. In order to verify the calculation results, this paper introduces the representative station of the main stream of Qiantang River as an example. There are Fuchun River hydropower station and other power stations on the Qiantang River. The example calculation shows that the Wavelet Denoising Algorithm can well remove the noise of the runoff series of the main stream of Qiantang River.Accurate runoff prediction can provide basic support for power generation dispatching of downstream power stations.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Long-Term Prediction Model for Indoor Air Quality Based on Informer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: According to a relevant survey, the average indoor worker spends approximately 21 hours indoors per day. Therefore, maintaining good indoor air quality is particularly important for people's health. In this study, we employed the Informer model for indoor air quality prediction and investigated the impact of different parameter settings on prediction performance. By adjusting key parameters such as seq__len (input sequence length), label_len (decoder starting label length), and pred _len (prediction sequence length), we evaluated the model's performance on long-term sequence prediction tasks. The experimental results demonstrated the outstanding performance of the Informer model in long-term sequence prediction, with longer prediction lengths enhancing prediction accuracy while shorter prediction lengths may lead to a slight decrease in performance. The experimental results of this study confirmed the strong performance of the Informer model in long-term sequence prediction of indoor air quality. In particular, the model performed well in long sequence prediction tasks, achieving MSE and MAE values of 0.087 and 0.215, respectively, which significantly outperformed other time series prediction algorithms. Therefore, the Informer-based long-term sequence prediction model for indoor air quality can effectively forecast future indoor air quality, making it of great significance for protecting people's health.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection and Recognition Based on Improved Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: CT (Computerized Tomography) is an important means to diagnose COVID-19. The existing case classification research of COVID-19 is faced with problems such as unbalanced data, insufficient universality, insufficient accuracy and low recall rate. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an improved Faster R-CNN model to classify the CT images of patients with COVID-19. By adding attention mechanism, the receptive field and classification performance of the model are improved. Replace the ROI Pooling part of the original model with RoI Align, making the candidate box more accurate. The experimental results show that the recall rate of the improved model is 95.8%, the average precision is 72.4%, and the transmission rate is increased from 5 frames/s of the original model to 8 frames/s. By comparing with the original model and five existing models using the same CT dataset, the model in this paper is superior to the comparison model in terms of recall rate and average precision mean.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Game Model of Digital Product Innovation Enabled by 5G
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Digital transformation is the path to achieve high-quality economic development. Digital product innovation with 5G as an important infrastructure is one of the outstanding manifestations of digital transformation. By constructing a tripartite evolutionary game model of government, enterprises and consumers, this paper analyzes the conditions for government regulating, enterprise enabling innovation and consumer purchase, and explore the impact of risk sensitivity coefficient and loss avoidance coefficient on the stability of the system. According to the analysis results, relevant implications are proposed for promoting the implementation of 5G digital product innovation.

articleTitle: A Drainage Sealing Method and Experiment in Injection-Production Wells with High Temperature and High Pressure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Because the mechanical research of downhole tubing is limited by the downhole mechanical detection device, a “pressure cap + ferrule” drainage sealing method is proposed to meet the drainage sealing requirements of the downhole mechanical detection device. The drainage sealing device has been manufactured and the indoor pressure seal experiment has been carried out. The results showed that the drainage sealing device met the sealing requirements of 30 MPa hydraulic pressure, and 80 °C high temperature using the pressure-resistant sealing experimental device. The drainage sealing device was installed on the downhole mechanical detection device, and the whole equipment was lowered to the DXX-162-X20 well of Shengli Oilfield to carry out the downhole experiment. The drainage sealing device worked in the downhole environment of 0–100 °C and 0–30 MPa, and successfully detected the downhole fluid pressure. The drainage sealing method proposed in this work provides reference for the research of downhole mechanical detection device, and is helpful for the mechanical research of downhole tubing, and reduces the injection-production operation accidents.

articleTitle: Application of GPTMap Mapping Software for Fine Description of Reservoirs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the gradual development of the oilfield, improving the reservoir mapping efficiency is an inevitable requirement in the adjustment of the oilfield development. GPTMap reservoir mapping software can draw various geological maps such as sediment phase zone map, reservoir parameter contour map, tectonic map, stratigraphic comparison map, reservoir profile map and raster map, which can provide accurate dynamic and static data basis for oilfield development and adjustment easily and quickly, and meet the need of improving reservoir mapping efficiency in oilfield development and adjustment.

articleTitle: Can Digital Feedback Promote the Use of Mobile Internet by the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In the context of an aging population and the intertwined information age, the digital divide among the elderly has become more prominent due to the increasingly extensive coverage of the “digital sentinel” construction. The digital feedback of children or grandchildren are important for bridging the digital divide of the elderly. In this paper, CFPS data in 2020 were selected to explore whether the frequency of intergenerational two-way life care, relationship, meeting and contact can help older people use mobile Internet through OLS and binary logistic regression. The conclusions show that close intergenerational relationships and high frequency of contact increase the probability of digital refeeding behavior, while older adults whose children are not around to care for them and who see each other less frequently have a higher need to use mobile Internet to communicate. The aim is to help the elderly integrate into the digital era and better enjoy the digital dividend through digital feedback, and also to lay a solid foundation for the popularization and application of the smart elderly industry.

articleTitle: 4D Visualization of Aircraft Wake Based on Godot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The vortices formed at the wingtips of an aircraft operating at high speed can pose a significant threat to the following aircraft. To visualize and track aircraft wake and realize the dynamic adjustment of aircraft wake interval, a 4D virtual simulation system of wake based on Godot 3D engine was designed by simplifying the aerodynamic wake vortex dissipation model. The environment scene is constructed by using modeling tools, and the real-time visualization method of aircraft wake evolution is established with the aircraft operation and meteorological parameters as input. Finally, the construction framework of the aircraft wake 4D simulation platform is given. The simulation results show that the given construction method can quickly simulate the 4D evolution of the wake in different scenarios, which is helpful to assist the controller in making decisions and is of great significance for reducing aircraft wake encounters.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Simulation Software in Chemical Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, the 3D simulation software is applied to the teachers' teaching and students' pre-class preview, in-class drill and after-class review. The software can be used immediately with or without the Internet. The 3D simulation software involves in the laboratory management, experimental safety, basic quality of laboratory personnel and other aspects involved in chemical experiments. At the same time, the chemical experiment waste can also be effectively treated in the 3D simulation software. The software provides many materials for teachers and students. The students can use this software to evaluate the learning effect and lay a foundation for their internship and employment. The simulation software covers a wide range and it is comprehensive and practical.

articleTitle: Hemispherical Resonator Gyro Error Self-Calibration Method Based on Standing Wave Precession
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, based on the control equation of the hemispherical resonant gyroscope, the gyroscope error model of the resonator under the influence of manufacturing process defects and control line delay is established. The model solves the error coupling problem in the detection signal through the error decoupling method, and designs a drift error self-calibration method based on standing wave precession. In this method, the gyro standing wave mode shape is actively precessed by actively applying control force, and the drift and scale error in the gyro output are excited and compensated in real time. And the effectiveness of the standing wave precession drift self-compensation method in gyro error compensation is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Free Space Detection Method Based On SENet Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The free space based on deep learning object detection still has some uncertainties when detecting static boundary or dynamic obstacle boundary, this will make it impossible to make effective track planning and state decision for vehicle running state, therefore, we need to modify the semantic edge information by matching the results of curb, lane line and target box and define the free space from the vector envelope or raster diagram. Secondly, the detection of driving area may be affected by light, dust, heavy snow and fog, therefore, it is necessary to fully combine vision and radar for obstacle detection to ensure its detection stability. In the process of free space detection, sensors such as cameras and lidar are easily affected by the environment, light conditions and extreme weather will affect the accuracy of the detection results of free space, in the traffic jam section, the occlusion caused by the surrounding vehicles will also affect the accuracy of the detection results of the free space. This paper refers to a CNN data fusion architecture, called RoadSeg, it can from the RGB image feature extraction and fusion, and deduce the surface normal information supplied, so as to realize the free space of accurate detection [1]. We introduced SENet on RoadSeg[2] called SE-RoadSeg to make some results more accurate.

articleTitle: A New Heart Rate Detection Scheme Based on Genetic Algorithm for VME Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Respiration and heartbeat are an important vital characteristic, and their accurate measurement is an important basis for determining whether the cardiopulmonary activity is normal or not. For the convenience of the patients, non-contact vital signs detection technology by Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar has great potential. Among the current vital signs detection techniques, Variational Mode Extraction (VME) has been recognized as a powerful tool for accurate vital signs detection. However, the traditional VME algorithm penalty factor usually uses empirical values of 2000 and 20000, which actually has the disadvantage of inaccurate heartbeat detection due to the complex and variable environment. In order to improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection, this paper proposes a VME heartbeat extraction scheme based on a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for optimizing parameter of VME. Extensive experiments are done for demonstrating the advantage of the proposed scheme, these experiments outcomes suggest that the mean absolute error (MAE) of heart rate evaluated by the proposed scheme is 1.03 beats per minute (bpm), which is 3 bpm more accurate than the traditional VME algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Security Technology and Protection Strategy of Digital Library Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The rapid development of modern computer network technology has also greatly promoted the development of libraries towards digitization and informatization. Especially in the context of the continuous improvement of China's comprehensive international competitiveness, the development model of various industries has also been fundamentally changed, which has led to the improvement of the application value of Network Computer in digital libraries. Based on this, this article conducts more in-depth research and discussion from three aspects: the application characteristics of digital library computer network security technology, the problems in the application of digital library computer network security technology, and the analysis of protective measures in the application of digital library computer network security technology.

articleTitle: Hospital Risk Assessment Based on Probabilistic Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to evaluate hospital risk more accurately, this paper proposes an uncertain multi-time risk assessment method based on ULWA and UDLWA operators. Firstly, the probabilistic language term set is used to describe the evaluation information of experts. Secondly, LWA2 operator is used to aggregate individual evaluation information into group evaluation information. Thirdly, considering the dynamic nature of evaluation information, ULWA and UDLWA operators are used to integrate multi-period evaluation information to sort risks. Finally, the method is applied to the risk assessment of Yantai Mountain Hospital to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis of Study on Shuowen Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: SPSS is a powerful tool that is capable of conducting nearly any type of data analysis used in the social sciences. It is a good method for multi-criteria decision making and allows the use of qualitative, as well as quantitative analysis in evaluation or forecast. Shuowen Jiezi is the first book in Chinese history to systematically explain the font of Chinese characters. The paper establishes a research model of Shuowen Jiezi based on SPSS. And the result shows an upward trend to the cultural research of Shuowen Jiezi will increase in the future.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Convolutional Network for Knowledge Graph Completion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Knowledge graphs reflect various facts in the actual world through formal representations and are interconnected through topological structures. However, most knowledge graphs are incomplete. Knowledge graph completion infers unknown or implie <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$d$</tex> facts based on existing facts. ConvKB is a typical CNN-based model that captures the translation properties between embedding units of the same dimension through one-dimensional convolution. Since one-dimensional convolution can only receive restricted semantic information, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$w$</tex> e use multi-scale convolution for capturing feature interactions between units of different dimensions. To further increase the number of interactions, we employ circular convolution. In our research, we introduce a simple and effective embedding model, named MCNKC, for knowledge graph completion. We demonstrate that MCNKC achieves better results than ConvKB on FB15K-237 and WN18RR.

articleTitle: Research on High Frequency Multi-Source New Energy Area Power Prediction Technology Under Complex Subsurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The current method of regional power prediction based on multi-source data reduces the dimensionality of multiple factors affecting power by principal component analysis, so as to achieve the prediction of regional power, which leads to poor accuracy of prediction results due to the lack of detailed division of regions. In this regard, the high-frequency multi-source new energy regional power prediction technique under complex subsurface is proposed. The K-means clustering algorithm is used to divide the prediction sub-region, and the benchmark wind farm is selected to establish the regional power prediction model. In the experiment, the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is verified. The analysis of the experimental results shows that the proposed method has a high degree of fit between the prediction results and the actual values when predicting the power of high-frequency multi-source new energy areas under complex substrates, and has a better prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Collision Detection Algorithm Based on Rigid Body and Soft Body Mixed Hierarchical Bounding Box
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: A collision detection algorithm based on mixed-level bounding boxes is proposed. Firstly, a balanced bounding box tree is established for the detected object, and then the tree node level is divided by the split plane division method. According to the characteristics of different bounding boxes, the triangular surface of geometry is divided by combining two bounding boxes to reduce the number of intersection tests, which can quickly complete the intersection test of geometry. The experimental results show that compared with the classical algorithm, it has a certain time advantage and can be used in collision detection between rigid and soft objects.

articleTitle: Design of Alcohol Distillation Control System Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper designs a PLC-based alcohol distillation process control system, which consists of an S7-200 control system and a monitoring and control system. The system is equipped with various testing and control devices for data acquisition of the distillation system temperature, pressure, flow rate and other detection quantities, and the upper computer is connected to the lower computer through Siemens' upper monitoring software WinCC to realize centralized control, so as to monitor the production process variables of the whole distillation system in real time and ensure safe production.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Short Video Danmaku Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In short video communication, the user's emotional analysis is the basis of exploring the communication law of video media. The short video danmaku contains important information to analyze the user's emotional tendency. So identifying the emotional tendency of the audience via short video danmaku is significant for the video media communication. A novel prediction model for short video danmaku emotion recognition is designed. Firstly, the short video audience's emotions are divided into five categories to construct the user's emotional space. Then the video danmaku is preprocessed by shallow learning model. Then the preprocessed text vector generated by the preprocessor is input into Bi(LSTM+GRU)-Att model to extract high level features. Finally the shallow learning model completes the danmaku emotion recognition. The prediction model not only fully extracts the text and semantic features of the context, but also improves the model's interpretability. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy reaches 87.7% and the accuracy on the test set reaches 99.6%. Therefore this model has high accuracy in short video danmaku emotion recognition. The proposed model can be used as a basic tool for short video propagation mechanism analysis.

articleTitle: Reducing Overfitting In Deep Neural Networks By Intra-class Decorrelation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Although deep learning models have achieved remarkable progress in various domains, the issue of overfitting remains a significant challenge. Our research proposes a novel regularization technique called ICD, that addresses this problem by enhancing generalization performance. We consider each hidden unit of a specific layer as a base-learner, and ICD regularization ensures the creation of diverse and non-redundant representations in deep learning models by minimizing intra-class cross-covariance among these base learners. Our experiments on diverse datasets and network architectures illustrate that ICD reduces overfitting and consistently enhances generalization performance.

articleTitle: Collision Detection Technique Based on the Spatial Decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a collision detection algorithm for a dynamic simulation system. This algorithm first conducts global search for obj ects, optimizes global detection through spatial decomposition, and uses spatial segmentation technology to map objects to spatial grids and quickly exclude adjacent but disjoint objects. In the process of accurate collision detection, the data structure of the hash table is used to save the geometric information of the objects, and the parallel algorithm is used to update the hash table to further improve the rate of the parallel algorithm. The experiment shows that the algorithm can ensure the authenticity of flexible fabric collision detection, and the space complexity and time complexity are relatively low, which can solve the flexible fabric simulation problem of time-consuming and large space.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Geological Modeling and Optimization Design of Horizontal Well Area Based on Petrel Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, in view of the characteristics of thin thickness, poor physical properties and non-homogeneity of the grapevine formation in oil field A, from the geological understanding of oil field A, based on fine tectonic interpretation, seismic inversion and fine sedimentary phase study, a fine 3D geological model of oil field A, including tectonic model and lithology model, was established by using Petrel software and sequentially indicated stochastic modeling method, which can accurately describe the spatial distribution of perspective reservoir properties, It can accurately describe the spatial distribution of the perspective reservoir properties, calculate their reserves and errors, compare each risk development model, design well locations and drilling trajectories, and then carry out research on the optimization design of horizontal well trajectories. It provides technical support and directional guidance for the subsequent development of horizontal wells.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia Remote Interactive Technology in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Teaching Chinese as a foreign language with multimedia Tele-interactive technology has received a lot of attention in recent years as an emerging teaching method, and we have conducted an empirical study to explore its practicality and effectiveness. Teachers can use the multimedia remote interactive network platform to organize students to consolidate and flexibly apply what they have learnt, and are able to conduct timely tests, giving students more opportunities to engage in learning at a cognitive level. However, there are limitations to teaching Chinese as a foreign language with multimedia tele-interactive technology, which can be a useful addition to offline Chinese language teaching if strengths and weaknesses can be avoided and appropriate measures taken.

Author Keywords: Teaching Chinese as a foreign language

articleTitle: Modular Teaching Practice of Online Course in Military Vocational Education Based on Minitab Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to improve the “trinity” new military personnel training system of military academy education, military training practice and military vocational education, we try to adjust and optimize the teaching concept, teaching means and teaching methods of mathematical statistics online in the teaching of probability statistics of military vocational education courses. In teaching, through the Minitab software of computer technology, we have made active teaching exploration in data analysis, probability theory, statistics and experimental design, which is very helpful to improve the teaching results of probability and statistics.

articleTitle: Overview of On-Site Calibration Techniques for Low-Frequency Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This article is about low-frequency power transmission technology, which is an emerging power transmission technology that has gradually shown technical and economic advantages in typical scenarios such as long-distance and large-capacity power transmission and offshore wind power delivery in recent years. This article will systematically introduce the relevant principles, methods and development trends of low-frequency (20Hz) electric power transformer on-site calibration technology to provide theoretical basis for further improving the accuracy and reliability of low-frequency transformer calibration technology. This article will first introduce the basic principles and application fields of low-frequency electric power transformers, and then focus on discussing on-site calibration methods and technologies, including on-site calibration methods inside stations, on-site calibration methods outside stations, as well as calibration instruments and equipment. Next, it will explore the development trend and challenges of on-site calibration technology, summarize this paper, and look forward to future research directions.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Quality Assessment of Chinese-English Neural Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing correlation between the machine assessment and the human assessment, translation quality assessment has drawn great attention from a lot of machine translation researchers. Therefore, it is of great significance to conduct researches on approaches to sentence-level translation quality assessment. A present, such approaches are mainly from three different angles: traditional machine learning, neural networks, and pretrained language models. The neural networks translation is able to, although to some extent, identify the underlying syntactic structures of the source language, it cannot appropriately translate the syntax within the sentences from a linguistic perspective. Therefore, this paper proposes a simple but effective model to solve it by making use of Transformer. This model consists of Transformer bottleneck layer networks and two-way long short-term memory networks. Parameters of Transformer bottleneck layer are preliminarily optimized through bilingual parallel corpus, and all parameters of the model are jointly optimized and slightly adjusted through translation quality assessment corpora. The experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the model accuracy of the translation quality assessment.

articleTitle: Conjugacy of Arbitrary n-Fold Mixing of Rohlin's Problem in Topological Sense
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The Rohlin's problem is the leading problem in ergodic theory. This problem is closely related to harmonic analysis, probability theory, combinatorial number theory and so on. This paper mainly uses the topological conjugate with a special metric in topological dynamical system to study twofold mixing implies arbitrary n-fold mixing, where twofold mixing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu(\mathrm{A}\cap \mathrm{T}^{-\mathrm{n}}\mathrm{B})\rightarrow\mu(\mathrm{A})\mu(\mathrm{B}), \mathrm{n}\in\mathrm{J}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}\rightarrow\infty()$</tex>[7]. From this we can obtain the recursive relation satisfying the special conditions. Thus twofold mixing implies arbitrary mixing for the order infinite system.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of the Whole Process of Cost Management of UHV Power Transmission and Transformation Project
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper draws on the key chain theory, project management theory, and multi-objective decision identification based on fuzzy set theory to identify the key chain of cost management. Guided by the process re-engineering theory, this paper optimizes the management process of key links to solve the problem of UHV engineering cost management. After optimizing the process, the efficiency of individual processes will be improved to a certain extent, in addition, the overall management efficiency of UHV engineering costs will be greatly improved due to the standardized transformation of each individual process, so as to realize the optimization of the overall system of UHV engineering. This paper compares and analyzes other domestic industries and advanced cost management models represented by the United States, the United Kingdom and Japan, and summarizes and refines the advanced experience for reference.

articleTitle: Hotspots and Evolutionary Trends of China's Critical Discourse Analysis Research
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA) has been developed for more than 30 years since Fairclough first proposed it in 1989. This paper uses literature analysis network CNKI and the visualization software CiteSpace to analyze the literature related to Chinese critical discourse analysis journals. Three conclusions were drawn: (1) CDA has widely absorbed theories from other disciplines, such as translation, corpus linguistics, and cognitive linguistics, and has increasingly evolved into a multidisciplinary integration. (2) News media provide a forward-looking analytic corpus for critical discourse analysis, and news discourse strategies and identity construction have been the hotspots of applied research on CDA. (3) The study approaches and objects of CDA tend to be diversified and integrated, making macro-analysis and micro-analysis complement each other, complementing qualitative and quantitative methods, improving the accuracy and thoroughness of CDA and widening the route of CDA research.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Complex Staggered-Flow Multi-Effect Evaporation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The process of multi-effect evaporation system studied in this paper has certain particularity, the models built by domestic and foreign scholars are not applicable to the system. Therefore, a mathematical model of the complex staggered-flow multi-effect evaporation system was established and solved according to the seven-effect evaporation process of the system and the principles of mass conservation and energy conservation. Measurable data from the field were taken for comparison to verify the validity of the model and provide some reference value for similar process system modeling studies.

articleTitle: Efficient Hierarchical Surround Box Construction Method Based on Ray Tracing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This paper proposes an effective construction method based on the complete tree enclosure box. Using the vector unit and CPU vector expansion function, the geometry crossing test is quickly and effectively realized through ray tracing. Due to the large consumption of ray tracing resources, it can be executed in parallel under multiple CPU through the complete tree enclosure box. The experimental results show that the geometric structure of the proposed method has some advantages, and some aspects over the classical algorithm, which can be used for collision detection in virtual space.

articleTitle: The Optimization of path Planning for a Picking Robot Based on an Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Regarding the issue that the convergence speed of traditional ant colony algorithms is often slow, the quality of the solution needs to be improved, and it is easy to fall into local optimal solutions. This article proposes an improved ant colony algorithm.
