Based on the traditional ant colony algorithm, combined with the suboptimal solution path obtained by optimizing the A* algorithm, introducing heuristic factors and pheromone volatilization factors and adjusting the deadlock update strategy to reduce the number of turns and avoid entering a deadlock state. Speed up the convergence speed of the algorithm and improve the quality of the solution. Experimental results show that compared with traditional ant colony algorithms, the improved ant colony algorithm in this paper can effectively reduce the number of turns while reducing the shortest path length and has strong stability.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis and Countermeasure Research on the Number of College Graduates Based on G (1,1) Grey Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: As an important talent resource, college graduates are related to the economic and social development of the country and region. Based on the data of the number of national graduates from 2013 to 2018, the GM (1,1) model meeting the accuracy requirements is established by using the grey system theory, and the number of graduates from 2019 to 2021 is used to test the accuracy of the model, and finally the number of graduates from 2022 to 2026 is predicted and analyzed. The results show that the GM (1,1) model meets the accuracy requirements and is suitable for the prediction of the number of graduates. In the next five years, the number of college graduates in China will continue to rise, and the employment situation is still grim, so measures should be taken from the three perspectives of the state, schools and individuals to provide a guarantee for alleviating the employment pressure.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization method of grid voltage proportional feedforward strategy based on second-order band-pass filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The grid voltage proportional feedforward strategy based on the second-order band-pass filter has a simple control structure and can well suppress the disturbance of the grid low frequency background harmonic to the output current of grid-connected inverter, so this strategy is widely used in practical applications, but the control delay in the digital control of the grid-connected inverter weakens the grid harmonic suppression capability. Based on this, this paper proposes a parameter optimization method of second-order band-pass filter for the above feedforward strategy. This method can improve the grid harmonic suppression capability of the grid voltage proportional feedforward strategy based on the second-order band-pass filter while considering the control delay. Finally, the effectiveness of this strategy is verified through simulation result.

Author Keywords: Grid voltage proportional feedforward based on second-order band-pass filter

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Control Technology for Power Plant 3D Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: By building a thermal power 3D project data management and control center, the project information data is centrally managed online, and the hierarchical and decentralized 3D approval is timely and flexible, providing data analysis and decision support for platform management optimization. Through 3D project intelligent management and control technology, research and development model release and intelligent clash check module, model normalization design control module, drawing control module, after model compliance, it will automatically enter the review and publication process, drawings, data, model linkage, platform instead of human management, Reduce drawing and data verification time, make people focus on design optimization, comprehensively improve design efficiency, and greatly improve design quality.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Mobility of Electrons and Holes in Chains With Different Types of Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The different mobility of electrons and holes determines the performance characteristics of electronic devices built from complex materials. The analysis of physical phenomena in bipolar transistors is carried out. A switching circuit with a common emitter was chosen, which allows to study the currents and voltages of the base and collector. It is shown that the characteristics of a bipolar transistor are significantly influenced by the metal-semiconductor contact potential differences at its junction with conductors in a real circuit. The erroneous description of transistors with the hypothesis of feedback of collector and base voltages is revealed. The increase in the input voltage of the base-emitter (modulo) when the collector potential is applied and the current value is maintained is caused: in the npn transistor by a drop in the average energy of electrons coming to the base contact, and in the pnp transistor by the same drop in the average energy of electrons that enter the emitter from the collector. The material of the article is aimed at students studying electronics and engineer researchers working in the semiconductor industry. The adopted concept, together with the constructive solution of the semiconductor device, the properties of the metals used to actually connect the transistors.

articleTitle: Recommendation Algorithms Based on User Reviews and Scoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: This study offers a recommendation algorithm based on user reviews and ratings to overcome the sparsity issue of the rating matrix and the problem of incorrect suggestions resulting from utilizing rating data alone. Two parallel convolutional neural network models are used to extract the text features in user and item reviews simultaneously by setting up shared layers to obtain two matrices of user preferences and item attributes about the reviews, which are then combined to generate the rating matrix for review prediction. The rating matrix is dissected using a hidden semantic model approach to create two matrices of user preferences and item characteristics about ratings. These are then merged to obtain the rating matrix for rating prediction. For the feature fusion portion of reviews and ratings, the predicted rating matrices for reviews and ratings are combined using a multilayer perceptron architecture to generate the final rating prediction matrix. The algorithmic model suggested in this research fuses review and rating data and is thus able to rectify inaccurate data during feature fusion and has some improvement on the cold start issue, when fresh users or objects are available with inadequate data for modeling. Experiments demonstrate that the algorithmic model suggested in this research is superior to the original recommended algorithmic model for ratings or reviews regarding rating prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Source Tracing Method of Three-Phase Unbalance Based on Equivalent Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The three-phase imbalance phenomenon of power system under normal operation has aroused the increasing concern of power supply and consumption departments, which will have a certain impact on the power quality of the grid. It is urgent to determine the source of imbalance in the complex distribution system, and then take appropriate governance measures to solve the problem of three-phase imbalance in power system. How to determine the location of the unbalanced disturbance source is particularly important for taking further control measures. However, the existing methods require that the power quality testing instrument used to measure the phase requires high accuracy and may cause error in judgment when the negative sequence current is less than a certain range of the measuring instrument. Therefore, following the modeling idea of harmonic source load equivalent circuit, this paper equates the unbalanced load as the parallel connection of negative sequence current source and impedance. By comparing the three-phase unbalanced voltage contribution level of the system side and load side at the measuring point, the location of the main three-phase unbalanced source can be distinguished. The method is simple and effective and has certain advantages in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on the Multilingual Corpus Translation Platform Based on Word Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, there are some problems in translation teaching. For example, classroom teaching is covered by the teacher 'tasks, which leads to students' weak initiative and obscure translation features. By establishing a multilingual corpus teaching platform based on the transformer model, this paper briefly outlines its methods and the code operation mode in the process of translation, and innovates the translation teaching methods by using computer algorithms and other related knowledge. Through the design of computer language, this paper builds a translation teaching platform to improve the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Thermal Design Method of Printed Circuit Board Based on Heat Transfer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of realizing the thermal design method of printed circuit board, we propose a thermal design method of printed circuit board based on heat transfer model. Based on the basic heat transfer model, heat conduction model, convection model, and radiation model, a reliable and applicable method is designed to control the temperature of the components assembled on the printed circuit board to ensure the safety and long-term operation of the circuit board. The design method is based on the design process of the printed circuit board, and the specific method of the thermal design of the printed circuit board is proposed from the aspects of component selection, device layout, and printed circuit board wiring. The test results show that the proposed thermal design method of the printed circuit board can effectively control the temperature of the assembled components and ensure the normal operation of the circuit board.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Measurement Method of OBD Online Monitoring System for Heavy-Duty Diesel Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: To ensure the accuracy and reliability of the OBD online monitoring system for heavy-duty diesel vehicles, and improve the effectiveness of monitoring and screening heavy-duty diesel vehicle exhaust emissions, a digital metrological calibration method is proposed. Firstly, this paper introduces the definition, composition, policy, and application of the OBD online monitoring system for heavy-duty diesel vehicles, and expounds the standards, technical indicators and measurement status of the system. Then, this paper introduces the digital measurement methods of the OBD online monitoring system for heavy-duty diesel vehicles from the aspects of digital measurement and calibration methods for engine emission data, traceability methods for on-board terminal calibration devices, and uncertainty evaluation. Finally, the necessity, shortcomings, and development trend of digital metering for heavy-duty diesel vehicle OBD online monitoring system are summarized.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of SSM-Based Booking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: With the gradual improvement and development of the tourism industry, the passenger flow of trains is large, and tourists from all over the world continue to increase, so the information management system of railway stations points out higher regulations. With the increasing maturity of computer ticketing technology, design and develop a ticketing system to improve the efficiency of all departments of the entire ticketing system. In view of the construction requirements of the booking system, the development design is mainly divided into front-end and back-end development, with the front-end being the web page and the back-end being the database. The software used in the development of the system is open source and free, using Eclipse as the development environment, JSP as the programming language, and MySQL as the server-side database. The main contents of the background management of the system include login, shift management, authority management, user management, order information management, passenger management, publicity management, message information management, etc. The main contents of the front desk include registration, login, personal information management, ticket information inquiry, my order, password change, etc. The simple and guiding interface design of the system makes it easier for users and managers to accept and use, and helps to carry out efficient business processing and information maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Paid Members' Continuous Use Intention of Video Website
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, paid members of video websites are taken as the research objects, and the factors that influence paying members' willingness to use continuously are emphatically analyzed. From the perspective of paying members, based on the expectation confirmation model, combined with the relevant characteristics of video websites, four variables, namely video resources, membership permission, consumption habits and membership prices, are introduced to construct a research model of influencing factors of paid members' continuous use intention. After reliability, validity, correlation analysis and regression analysis, it is concluded that consumption habits and satisfaction significantly and positively affect the continuous use intention, so as to give some reasonable suggestions to website operators to improve products, enhance user experience and increase user loyalty.

articleTitle: Application and Regulation of Algorithm Technology in Automated Decision Making for Law Enforcement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The key of generating automated decision for law enforcement lies in the data and the analysis of the data by algorithmic technology, which is mainly used in traffic police off-site law enforcement, automated public credit evaluation, and automated approval. Although the using of algorithmic technology in automated decision making can improve the efficiency of law enforcement and regulate discretion, there are problems such as the possibility of mistakes made by intelligent machines, algorithmic black boxes, challenges to the legitimacy of procedures, and the difficulty of converting uncertain legal concepts. When standardizing the application of algorithm technology in law enforcement, it is important to distinguish the application fields, attach importance to the algorithm interpretation, and establish the algorithm accountability mechanism.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Bus Departure Interval based on NSGA-III Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional bus does not properly take into account the interests of passengers, enterprises and the cooperation between bus and rail, a multi-variable, three-objective and double-constraint elastic departure interval model based on NSGA-III (Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-III) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, under the constraints of departure interval and full load rate, the optimization model with three minimum objectives of passenger waiting time cost, transfer waiting time cost and enterprise operating mileage cost was established. Secondly, the Pareto frontier was screened by NSGA-III algorithm of platEMO platform in MATLAB. Finally, taking Chongqing 108 line as an example, the optimal elastic departure interval is calculated. The results show that the algorithm is effective in bus scheduling and the model has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Three-Dimensional Modeling Method Based on Computer Visualization Software: 3Ds MAX and Sketch Up
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this study, we applied this method to virtual three-dimensional campus construction and compared and analyzed two different three-dimensional software modeling methods: 3DMAX and Sketch Up. By summarizing their respective advantages, we created a complete three-dimensional scene. To achieve basic functions such as vector data recording, three-dimensional browsing, and animation production, we used C# language and AutoCAD and Lumion computer visualization software for secondary development. Experimental results show that the joint modeling method proposed in this study integrates the advantages of 3DsMax and Sketch Up software and combines them with AutoCAD and Lumion computer visualization software, successfully avoiding the problem of format mismatch caused by multi-software modeling. Furthermore, this method shortens the modeling cycle and reduces the difficulty of scene modeling. Therefore, it provides a convenient solution for the rapid construction of large-scale three-dimensional scenes.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Focus of the Post-Graduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: “For twenty years, our initial aspiration to forge ahead and excel in mathematical contest in modeling remains unchanged.” On the occasion of the twentieth anniversary of China post-graduate mathematical contest in modeling, this article discusses some focal issues of mathematical modeling training that teachers in universities and colleges are concerned about: how to build a coaching team, give lectures on mathematical modeling, and balance the uneven level of post-graduates' mathematical modeling skills, how to use visualization in modeling, and how to improve postgraduates' programming skills. This article shares experience in the training of mathematical contest in modeling, and cultivates innovative talents among postgraduates.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Detection Based on Attention Mechanism and Deep Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: To address the problem of incomplete graph structure features due to the lack of contextual information in existing graph neural network-based vulnerability mining methods and the problem of over-smoothing that prevents the model from learning higher-order features of the graph structure resulting in poor prediction performance, a vulnerability detection method based on deep graph convolutional networks and attention mechanism, PSG-GCNIIAT, is proposed. PSG fuses order relational graphs on the basis of program dependency graphs so that code statements have the ability to sense their contextual information, and generates embedding vectors of code lines by abstracting syntax trees to achieve deep structure feature extraction of graph nodes. GCNIIAT uses a deep graph convolutional network, GCNII, combined with a graph attention mechanism to more effectively identify graph structure features of program slices associated with vulnerabilities. The experimental results show that the vulnerability detection model GCNIIAT proposed in this paper has obvious advantages over Vuldeepecker, GCN and GGNN in accuracy and F1 value indicators, and can effectively improve the performance of program vulnerability detection.

articleTitle: Application of Text Analysis and Machine Learning Algorithms in Improving Satisfaction of Urban Green Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this study, we apply text analysis and machine learning algorithms to study how to improve the satisfaction of Xiamen's green development. Through binary logical regression and the XGBoost algorithm, we find out the important factors that affect the satisfaction of Xiamen's green development and establish a logical regression equation. Through the public complaint text and reply text data captured in the consultation and complaint module of the Xiamen Ecological Environment Bureau, we establish the word frequency statistics and semantic networks. According to the research results, we proposed strategies to improve the satisfaction of green development in Xiamen.

articleTitle: The Estimate Severity Level of Cotton Verticillium Wilt Using New Multi-spectra of UAV Comprehensive Monitoring Disease Index
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Verticillium wilt is one of the important diseases of cotton. In severe cases, it can lead to a reduction in cotton production or even no harvest. The severity level of Verticillium wilt of cotton were estimated by using the VAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) multi-spectral Comprehensive monitoring disease index model, it can provide reference for estimating crop diseases. Dates were acquired from UAV multi-spectral image data and ground survey, correlation coefficient method and the best exponential factor method were used to select the best vegetation index and best band combination, A new UAV multi-spectral Comprehensive monitoring disease index was created, and four kinds of regression models which were on the new disease Comprehensive index were established to estimate cotton disease severity. The results show that cotton plants with different severity of Verticillium wilt have different spectral characteristics in the near-infrared and visible light bands. Namely, the disease severity increasing, the spectral reflectance of cotton canopy of disease was show an upward trend in the visible light band (470nm~656nm), however, a downward trend in the near-infrared band (710nm~950nm). DVI, B3-B5-B8 were the best vegetation index and best band combination for identify cotton disease by UAV multi-spectral data, respectively. A new index, that was B-RBDVI (RB (3-5-8) +DVI), named UAV multispectral Comprehensive monitoring disease index was created through combination DVI and B3-B5-B8. With this Comprehensive index as the independent variable, the regression models of multiple linear, partial least squares, principal component analysis and support vector machine were established to estimate the cotton disease severity. The R2 of the prediction set of the four regression estimation models were 0.879 -0.912, with a difference of 0.065-0.079 in RMSE. The R2 of the validation set is between 0.88-0.89, with a difference of 0.08-0.09 in RMSE. Among them, the support vector machine regression model has the highest accuracy (prediction set R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.91, RMSE=0.07; validation set R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.89, RMSE=0.08), it will be as the best monitoring model of UAV for monitoring cotton disease severity.

articleTitle: Inner Connection Among Translation Psychology, Probability Theory and Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: The development of the recurrent neural network (RNN) in machine translation (MT) has greatly improved its translation speed and accuracy. Although a larger proportion of the discourse power of MT is increasingly taken in translation activities, MT cannot monopolize human translation due to the probability algorithm. There are two reasons. First, the order and format of some texts will affect the accuracy of machine translation according to the algorithm of probability theory. Second, “memory” is not only an indispensable core technique in machine translation but also an insurmountable component in translation psychology. Although the current research on MT based on RNNs has made some achievements, it is still impossible to obtain the most scientific combination mode of the parts of speech according to probabilistic computing; therefore, the machine itself cannot distinguish the correctness of the source language, which leads to the fact that the input of the source language with the wrong structure may still obtain the correct translation. This paper explores possible ways to optimize MT by researching the internal relations among probability theory, translation psychology and MT.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Sericulture Management System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: At present, intelligent and equipped sericulture has become an inevitable trend for the high-quality development of modern sericulture. However, sericulture in the past is still facing practical problems such as labor shortage, outdated equipment, complicated control, low standards, and lax regulations. It is urgent to change the way of sericulture. Based on the research on intelligent monitoring of sericulture environment, the development of intelligent sericulture management system based on intelligent perception and processing is discussed. Combining intelligent and large-scale sericulture real scenes, relying on the intelligent perception technology of the Internet of Things, the environmental elements of sericulture and the developmental status of silkworms are intelligently sensed, identified, transmitted, and processed, and the development process and environmental conditions of sericulture are accurately grasped. Using the deep residual neural network algorithm (DRCNN), multi-feature data extraction and hierarchical fusion processing, timely correction of sericulture data standards, real-time monitoring of sericulture production process, output technical solutions, and provide automated sericulture decision-making. It provides a reference for building an intelligent and equipped compatible platform for sericulture.

articleTitle: Development of Low-Frequency Standard Voltage Transformer and Research on Measurement Traceability Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: Voltage transformer usually works in AC 50Hz or DC environment, flexible low-frequency AC transmission in voltage transformer requires to run at 20Hz, and frequency is a key factor affecting the error, the prior art voltage transformer has been difficult to meet the flexible low-frequency AC transmission engineering measurement accuracy and operation safety and stability requirements. At present, the research on voltage transformers and their measurement transfer technology adapted to low-frequency transmission scenarios is still blank. In this paper, we will study the working principle of voltage transformer, analyze the influence mechanism of frequency on error, and develop a low-frequency standard voltage transformer suitable for low-frequency voltage transformer verification. The advantages and disadvantages of standard voltage transformers of electromagnetic standard voltage transformer and capacitive voltage standard device are analyzed and compared, and a voltage transformer value traceability method and quantity transmission system based on the low-frequency transmission scenario of dual standard transmission are proposed, which realizes the accurate transmission of low-frequency standard voltage transformer value to solve the problem of inaccurate transmission of low-frequency standard voltage transformer.

articleTitle: Dynamic Assessment of Urban Interdependent Infrastructure Failure Risk Under Heavy Rainfall and Flooding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Seminar on Computer Science and Engineering Technology (SCSET)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the failure of critical urban electricity and water infrastructure under heavy rainfall and flooding, and analyze the multiple associations that lead to the failure. The multiple associations are classified and defined based on their causes, mechanisms and scope of influence. The coupling mechanism and dynamic evolution process of multiple correlations are analyzed with respect to the spatial and temporal evolution characteristics of heavy rainfall and flooding disasters. A joint probabilistic approach is used to couple the multiple associations and construct a multiple association dynamic evolution network to dynamically assess the failure risk of urban electricity and water critical infrastructure.
